rules.note: I am, he is, they are
ex: I am hungry.
She is a doctor.
They are ready.
It is cold today.
mistakes: She be a teacher → She is a teacher
I is hungry → I am hungry
rules.topicCn: 基本句型与 be 动词

rules.note: I'm not tired. He isn't here. They aren't ready.
ex: I'm not a student.
He isn't tired.
We aren't ready.
mistakes: He don't tired → He isn't tired

rules.note: Is she a teacher? Are you cold? Am I late?
ex: Are you a student?
Is it expensive?
Where are they?
mistakes: Is you cold? → Are you cold?
Where he is? → Where is he?

ex: Is she ready? — Yes, she is.
Are they your friends? — No, they aren't.
mistakes: No, she is'nt → No, she isn't

rules.note: a dog, an apple, an hour, a university
ex: I saw a cat in the garden.
She is an engineer.
It took an hour.
mistakes: a apple → an apple

rules.note: the sun, the door, the book on the table
ex: The film we saw was amazing.
Could you pass the salt?
mistakes: The life is short → Life is short

rules.note: I like music. She plays tennis. He is from Russia.
ex: She speaks Spanish.
He plays basketball every day.
mistakes: I play the tennis → I play tennis
She speaks the Spanish → She speaks Spanish

rules.note: I work. He works. She goes. It runs.
ex: I drink coffee every morning.
She works in a hospital.
The Earth goes round the Sun.
mistakes: He go → He goes (go → goes)

ex: I don't eat meat.
He doesn't speak French.
They don't work here.
mistakes: He don't work → He doesn't work
I not like → I don't like

rules.note: Do you like pizza? Does he work here? Where do they live?
ex: Do you speak Russian?
Does she live nearby?
Where do you work?
mistakes: Does she likes? → Does she like?
Do he work? → Does he work?
Where she lives? → Where does she live?

rules.note: I know, not: I am knowing. I love, not: I am loving.
mistakes: I am knowing → I know
She is loving him → She loves him
He is wanting a coffee → He wants a coffee

ex: She is a teacher.
Tell him the truth.
Can you help me?
mistakes: Me like pizza → I like pizza
She told to him → She told him

rules.note: my book, her car, their house
ex: This is my phone.
Their dog is cute.
The cat hurt its paw.
mistakes: Its a big house → It's a big house (it's = it is)
Their friends is nice → Their friends are nice

rules.note: cats, boxes, knives, children, men, sheep
ex: one bus → two buses
one child → many children
mistakes: two childs → two children
three mans → three men

rules.note: this/these
ex: This is my bag.
Those shoes are expensive.
What is that?
mistakes: These is my pen → This is my pen
Those are that books → Those are those/the books

rules.note: There is a park. There are five rooms.
ex: There is a cinema near here.
Are there any shops nearby? — Yes, there are.

rules.note: in the box, on the table, at the station
ex: The keys are on the table.
She is in the kitchen.
Meet me at the entrance.

rules.note: Open your books. Don't run. Please sit down.
ex: Turn left at the crossroads.
Don't touch that!
Let's have a break.

rules.note: I can swim. She can't drive. Can I help you?
ex: I can speak three languages.
She can't come today.
Can you help me, please?
mistakes: I can to speak French → I can speak French

rules.note: What is this? Where do you live? How old are you?
ex: Where does she work?
What time is it?
How many brothers do you have?

rules.note: one, two, three... twenty-one, a hundred, a thousand
ex: She is twenty-three years old.
The ticket costs four hundred pounds.

rules.note: the first, the second, the third, the fourth... the twenty-first
ex: My office is on the third floor.
Today is the first of March.

rules.note: John's car, my sister's friend, the children's toys, the teachers' room
ex: This is Anna's laptop.
The children's toys are in the box.

rules.note: go to school, walk into the room, run across the street
ex: She walked into the room.
He ran across the street.
We drove through the forest.

rules.note: work→worked, play→played, stop→stopped, study→studied
ex: She worked all day yesterday.
They played tennis last Sunday.
mistakes: He is wanting → He wants (stative verb)

rules.note: go→went, see→saw, have→had, come→came, buy→bought
ex: I went to Paris last summer.
She saw a great film.
We had a meeting at 9.
mistakes: She goed → She went
I buyed → I bought

ex: I didn't see him yesterday.
She didn't come to work.
mistakes: I didn't went → I didn't go
She didn't came → She didn't come
Did she played? → Did she play ?
She didn't came → She didn't come
What he did? → What did he do?

rules.note: Did they arrive? What did he say?
ex: Did you enjoy the film?
Where did they go?
Who told you that?
mistakes: I think she go tomorrow → she will go

rules.note: I/he/she/it was. You/we/they were.
ex: I was very tired last night.
They were at home all day.
Was it expensive?
mistakes: She is going to does → she is going to do

rules.note: I'll call you back. It will rain tomorrow. I'll have the pasta.
ex: The phone is ringing. — I'll get it!
It will be cold tomorrow.

rules.note: I'm going to visit Paris. Look out
ex: I'm going to study medicine.
She's going to have a baby.
mistakes: She is going to does → She is going to do

rules.note: She is reading now. They are playing outside.
ex: I am studying English right now.
She's working from home this month.
mistakes: I was visit → I was visiting
She were working → She was working (she/he/it → was)
At 8 I was work → I was working

rules.note: I'm meeting Tom tomorrow. We're flying to Rome on Friday.
ex: I'm having dinner with Alex tonight.
They're getting married in June.
mistakes: We are flying to Rome on the Friday → on Friday
She knowing French → She knows French

rules.note: You should see a doctor. You shouldn't eat so much.
ex: You should exercise more.
She shouldn't work so hard.
mistakes: She should goes → She should go
I should have went → I should have gone

rules.note: You must wear a seatbelt. You mustn't smoke here.
ex: You must show your passport.
You mustn't smoke here.
mistakes: You mustn't to smoke → mustn't smoke

rules.note: I have to work late. She doesn't have to come.
ex: I have to finish this report by Friday.
You don't have to come if you don't want to.
mistakes: She doesn't have to don't come → She doesn't have to come
You must not to come → mustn't come

rules.note: She could swim when she was 5. Could you help me?
ex: She could play the violin as a child.
Could you speak more slowly, please?
mistakes: Can I when I was a child → I could when I was a child
Could you to speak slowly? → Could you speak slowly?

rules.note: bigger, more interesting, better, worse
ex: This film is more interesting than that one.
Today is worse than yesterday.
mistakes: She is more tall than → She is taller than
He is more better → He is better
She is tallest in class → She is the tallest

rules.note: the biggest, the most beautiful, the best
ex: This is the most expensive restaurant in the city.
He is the best player on the team.
mistakes: He is most clever → He is the most clever / the cleverest
She is the most best → She is the best

rules.note: I have some money. Do you have any? I don't have any.
ex: I bought some bread and some milk.
Is there any milk in the fridge?
I don't have any cash on me.
mistakes: I don't have some cash → I don't have any cash

rules.text: much / many / a lot of / a few / a little
ex: I don't have much time.
She has a few friends in London.
There is a little sugar left.
mistakes: A few water → A little water

rules.note: water, information, advice
ex: Can I have some information, please?
She gave me very useful advice.
mistakes: An information → Some information
Three furnitures → Three pieces of furniture

rules.note: in March, in 2024, in winter; on Monday, on 5 June; at 3pm, at night
ex: The meeting is at half past three.
She was born on the 12th of April.
I started this job in October.
mistakes: at Monday → on Monday
in 8 o'clock → at 8 o'clock
on the morning → in the morning
in my birthday → on my birthday

rules.note: for three years, since 2020, three years ago
ex: I've been here for six months.
She's worked here since 2020.
I saw him two days ago.
mistakes: I've been here since three years → for three years
Three days before → Three days ago

rules.note: It's cold, isn't it? You like jazz, don't you?
ex: It's a nice day, isn't it?
You don't like horror films, do you?
She can swim, can't she?
mistakes: It's cold, isn't he? → isn't it
She can swim, can't he? → can't she

rules.note: I've got a car. Have you got a pen? She hasn't got time.
ex: I've got two brothers.
Have you got the time?
She hasn't got any cash.

rules.note: She sings beautifully. He works hard. She drives fast.
ex: He explained it clearly.
She ran fast.
They worked hard all day.
mistakes: She sings beautiful → She sings beautifully
She drives fastly → She drives fast

rules.note: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never
ex: I usually wake up at 7.
She is never late for work.
They meet once a week.
mistakes: She always is late → She is always late (after to be)

rules.note: a lovely small old red Italian leather bag
ex: a lovely little old cottage
a big red Italian sports car

rules.note: I have seen it. She has gone. They have arrived.
ex: Have you ever eaten sushi?
I've just finished my homework.
She hasn't called yet.
mistakes: She has went → She has gone
I have been to Rome last year → I went to Rome last year

rules.note: Have you ever...? I've never... I've already... Not yet. I've just...
ex: Have you ever been to Scotland?
I've never eaten snails.
I've already seen that film.
She hasn't replied yet.
mistakes: I've already not finished → I haven't finished yet
Did you ever eat sushi? → Have you ever eaten sushi?

rules.note: I've lived here for 5 years / since 2019.
ex: She's worked here for ten years.
I've known him since university.
mistakes: I've lived here since five years → for five years
She's known him for 2019 → she's known him since 2019

rules.text: Present Perfect Continuous: have been + V-ing
rules.note: I have been waiting for an hour. She has been studying all day.
ex: I've been learning English for two years.
Why are your hands dirty? — I've been fixing the car.
mistakes: I've been learning since three hours → for three hours
I've been read all evening → I've been reading

rules.note: I was reading at 8pm. They were talking all evening.
ex: It was raining when I left home.
What were you doing at 7 yesterday?
mistakes: She was walk → She was walking
They was talking → They were talking
I was work at 9pm → I was working

rules.note: While I was cooking, he called. I was walking when it started to rain.
ex: She was having a bath when the phone rang.
While he was giving his speech, someone fell asleep.

rules.note: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
ex: If you heat ice, it melts.
If it rains, the streets get wet.
mistakes: When you mix them, you will get → you get

rules.note: If it rains tomorrow, I'll stay home.
ex: If she studies hard, she'll pass the exam.
If you need help, I can come.
mistakes: If she will study hard, she passes → If she studies, she will pass

rules.note: If I had a car, I would drive to work. If I were you...
ex: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
If I were taller, I'd play basketball.
mistakes: If I would have a car → If I had a car

rules.note: Coffee is grown in Brazil. The car is made in Germany.
ex: English is spoken in many countries.
The letter is written in French.
mistakes: Coffee is grew in Brazil → Coffee is grown
The letter wrote in French → The letter is written
English spoke here → English is spoken

rules.note: The bridge was built in 1890. They were arrested.
ex: The Eiffel Tower was built in 1889.
Three people were injured in the accident.
mistakes: The bridge was build in 1890 → was built
They was arrested → They were arrested
The car stolen → The car was stolen

rules.note: The car has been repaired. All invitations have been sent.
ex: The project has been completed.
All the guests have been informed.
mistakes: The project has been complete → has been completed
It have been sent → It has been sent
All guests have been inform → have been informed

rules.note: "I am tired." → He said he was tired.
ex: She said: 'I am leaving.' → She said she was leaving.
He told me: 'I can't come.' → He told me he couldn't come.
mistakes: He said me that → He told me that / He said that

rules.note: "Where do you live?" → She asked where I lived.
ex: "Where do you work?" → She asked where I worked.
"Are you married?" → He wanted to know if I was married.
mistakes: He asked me what was I doing → what I was doing
She asked if was I tired → if I was tired

rules.note: He said that... / He told me that...
ex: She said she needed help.
He told us the meeting was cancelled.
mistakes: He told that he was late → He said that / He told me that
She said me the news → She told me the news
They told about the problem → They talked about it / said something about it

rules.note: I enjoy reading. She finished writing. He avoided making mistakes.
ex: I enjoy swimming in the sea.
She's considering moving abroad.
He avoided making eye contact.
mistakes: I enjoy to swim → I enjoy swimming
She finished to write → She finished writing
He avoided to make → He avoided making

rules.note: I want to go. She decided to stay. He managed to finish.
ex: She decided to quit her job.
I hope to see you soon.
He failed to answer.
mistakes: She decided going → She decided to go
He wants going out → He wants to go out
I hope seeing you → I hope to see you

rules.note: I like reading = I like to read
ex: I love travelling / to travel.
She started working / to work here in May.

rules.note: I used to play football. She used to have long hair.
ex: I used to smoke, but I stopped.
Did you use to play an instrument?
mistakes: I use to play football → I used to play

rules.note: The man who called. The book that I read. The place where we met.
ex: The man who lives next door is very friendly.
The hotel where we stayed had a pool.
mistakes: The place who we met → the place where we met
The girl who's bag → the girl whose bag

rules.note: Although it was raining, we went out. Despite the rain, we went.
ex: Although she was tired, she kept working.
Despite the rain, he cycled to work.
It was expensive. However, it was worth it.

rules.note: I'll be working at 9 tomorrow. She'll be flying over the Atlantic.
ex: Don't call at 8 — I'll be having dinner.
This time next week I'll be sitting on a beach.
mistakes: I'll be work at 9 → I'll be working
She will working → She will be working

rules.note: By Friday I will have finished the report. By 2030 they will have built the bridge.
ex: I'll have finished this book by Sunday.
By 2050, scientists will have found a cure.
mistakes: I'll have finish by Sunday → I'll have finished

tags: by the end of the week
by the end of the year

rules.note: I study hard to pass. She left early so that she could catch the train.
ex: She studies hard in order to get a scholarship.
He left early so that he could catch the last train.
mistakes: I study hard for passing → I study hard to pass
She left early for that she could catch the train → so that she could
In order to not upset him → in order not to upset him

rules.note: give up, look up, turn off, find out, get on, put off, carry on
ex: I've given up smoking.
Can you look after my cat while I'm away?
We need to find out what happened.
mistakes: She gave up to smoke → She gave up smoking

rules.note: By the time she arrived, he had already left.
ex: When I arrived, she had already left.
He had never seen snow before that winter.
mistakes: When I arrived, she already left → she had already left
He had never see snow → He had never seen snow
I had went → I had gone

rules.text: Past Perfect Continuous: had been + V-ing
rules.note: He had been waiting for two hours when she arrived.
ex: She was exhausted — she'd been working all night.
How long had you been waiting before she arrived?
mistakes: She was exhausted — she had been work → she had been working
How long had you waiting? → How long had you been waiting ?

tags: for two hours when she arrived

rules.note: She must have forgotten.
ex: You must have been exhausted after that journey.
She must have left early — her coat is gone.
mistakes: She must forgot → She must have forgotten
He must have leave early → He must have left

rules.note: She can't have said that! He can't have been there.
ex: He can't have seen her — she was abroad.
That can't have been the right address.
mistakes: She can't forgot that → She can't have forgotten

rules.note: I should have called. You shouldn't have said that.
ex: I should have brought an umbrella.
She shouldn't have told him the secret.
mistakes: I should called her → I should have called
She shouldn't have went → She shouldn't have gone
You should have study → You should have studied

rules.note: She might have forgotten. It could have been worse.
ex: She might have forgotten about the meeting.
He could have left through the back door.
mistakes: She might forgot → She might have forgotten
He could have win → He could have won

rules.note: If I had studied harder, I would have passed.
ex: If she had taken the medicine, she would have recovered.
If he hadn't left early, he would have met her.
mistakes: If she had taken medicine, she would recovered → she would have recovered

ex: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
mistakes: If she were careful, she didn't break it → she wouldn't have broken it

rules.note: It will be done. It must be fixed. It should be checked.
ex: The report will be published tomorrow.
This mistake must be corrected immediately.
mistakes: The report will published → will be published
It must done → It must be done
It should be do → It should be done

rules.note: I had my hair cut. She got her car fixed.
ex: I need to have my teeth checked.
She had her house painted last spring.
mistakes: I cut my hair at the hairdresser → I had my hair cut
She got her car to fix → She got her car fixed

rules.text: Passive reporting verbs: It is said that... / He is believed to...
rules.note: It is thought that prices will rise. She is known to be honest.
ex: It is reported that three people were injured.
He is thought to have left the country.
mistakes: It is said that prices will risen → will rise
He is believed to being honest → He is believed to be honest

rules.text: stop / regret / mean + V-ing vs to-inf
ex: He stopped smoking last year.
She stopped to look at the view.

rules.note: I wish I knew the answer. I wish I had more time.
ex: I wish I spoke better English.
She wishes she lived in a warmer country.
mistakes: I wish I know the answer → I wish I knew

rules.note: I wish I had studied harder. I wish I hadn't said that.
ex: I wish I hadn't eaten so much.
She wishes she had taken that job offer.
mistakes: I wish she had took that job → she had taken

rules.note: I wish you would stop talking. I wish it would warm up.
ex: I wish you would listen to me.
I wish it would stop raining.
mistakes: I wish you stop talking → I wish you would stop
The person which I spoke → the person I spoke to

rules.note: It was so cold that we stayed inside. She worked hard; therefore, she passed.
ex: It was such a good book that I read it twice.
She missed the deadline; consequently, she lost the contract.

rules.text: be used to / get used to + V-ing
rules.note: I'm used to waking up early. She's getting used to the cold.
ex: I'm not used to getting up so early.
It took time, but she got used to the new system.
mistakes: I'm used to wake up early → I'm used to waking up (be used to + V-ing)
I get used to woke up → I get used to waking up

rules.text: Future in the Past: would / was going to
rules.note: She said she would call. He was going to leave.
ex: She promised she would be there.
He was about to leave when she called.
mistakes: He was going to called → He was going to call

rules.note: You are to report by Monday. They were never to meet again.
ex: You are to submit the report by Friday.
She was to become one of the greatest scientists of her time.
mistakes: You be to submit → You are to submit
She was be never to meet → She was never to meet

rules.note: You ought to apologise. She ought to have told us.
ex: You ought to apologise for what you said.
She ought to have told us earlier.
mistakes: She ought have told us → She ought to have told us

rules.note: You needn't worry. / She doesn't need to come.
ex: You needn't fill in both forms.
She doesn't need to attend every meeting.

rules.note: How dare you! I daren't ask. She dared to challenge him.
ex: How dare you speak to me like that!
She dared to express her opinion openly.

rules.note: I hurt myself. She did it herself. They enjoyed themselves.
ex: She taught herself to play the guitar.
The machine turns itself off automatically.
mistakes: They enjoyed themself → They enjoyed themselves
I did it by my own → I did it by myself

rules.note: The team are playing well. (BrE) / The team is playing. (AmE)
ex: The government have announced new measures. (BrE)
The audience were on their feet. (BrE)

rules.note: a half, three quarters, 5.7 = five point seven, 25%
ex: Three quarters of students passed the exam.
The inflation rate fell to 2.5 percent.
mistakes: Two third of students → Two thirds of students

rules.note: faster, more carefully, best, worse, further
ex: She spoke more confidently than before.
He works hardest in the team.
mistakes: She sings more beautiful → She sings more beautifully
He runs more fast → He runs faster
She works most hardly → She works hardest

rules.note: Never have I seen this. Rarely does she complain.
ex: Never have I seen anything so beautiful.
Rarely does she make a mistake.
Little did I know what was coming.
mistakes: Rarely she complains → Rarely does she complain

rules.note: Not only did he apologise, but he also offered to help.
ex: Not only is she talented, but she is also very hard-working.
Not only did they arrive late, but they also forgot the documents.
mistakes: Not only he apologised → Not only did he apologise

rules.note: Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.
ex: Hardly had she arrived when it started to rain.
No sooner had I sat down than someone knocked at the door.
mistakes: Hardly I had sat → Hardly had I sat
No sooner I sat than → No sooner had I sat than

rules.note: Had I known (= If I had known). Were I you (= If I were you).
ex: Had she told me, I would have helped.
Were I in your position, I would accept.
Should you need assistance, please call us.
mistakes: Have I known, I would have helped → Had I known

rules.text: It-cleft: It was John who called.
ex: It is hard work that leads to success.

rules.text: Wh-cleft: What surprised me was the price.
rules.note: What I need is rest. What she said shocked everyone.
ex: What I love about London is the diversity.
What he did was completely unexpected.

rules.note: I suggest he leave. It is vital that she be informed.
ex: I recommend that he see a doctor.
It is essential that all students attend the meeting.
mistakes: It is essential that she is informed → that she be informed

rules.note: It's high time you went to bed. It's time we left.
ex: It's time she found a new job.
It's high time you apologised.
mistakes: It's high time you will go → It's high time you went (Past Simple!)
It's high time for you go → It's high time you went

rules.note: She talks as if she knew everything. He looked as though he had seen a ghost.
ex: He spends money as if he were a millionaire.
She spoke as though she had met him before.
mistakes: He looked as if he seen a ghost → as if he had seen

rules.note: So do I. Neither does she. So am I.
ex: I love jazz. So does she.
I haven't been to Rome. Neither have I.
mistakes: Neither she does → Neither does she
I love jazz. So she does too → So does she

rules.text: I think so / I hope so / I'm afraid so
rules.note: Will it rain?
ex: Will he come? — I think so. / I don't think so.
Is it expensive? — I'm afraid so.
Is it closed? — I hope not.
mistakes: I think so not → I don't think so
I hope so not → I hope not

rules.note: The man who called is my brother. VS My brother, who called, is a doctor.
The company for which I work. The person with whom I spoke.
mistakes: The person who I spoke → the person I spoke to / to whom I spoke

rules.note: decide→decision, discover→discovery, improve→improvement
ex: She decided to expand. → Our decision to expand the company...
He discovered that... → His discovery of the error...

rules.note: The fact that prices increased → The increase in prices...
ex: There has been a significant improvement in air quality.
His refusal to comment surprised everyone.
mistakes: The prices' increase → The increase in prices

rules.note: Walking down the street, I saw an old friend. Having no money, he couldn't buy food.
ex: Arriving at the airport, he realised he had forgotten his passport.
Not knowing what to do, she called her mother.

rules.note: Written in 1815, the novel... Having finished work, she went home.
ex: Surprised by the news, she sat down silently.
Having finished the exam, the students left the room.

rules.note: Unless you study, you'll fail. As long as you're honest, I'll help.
ex: I'll lend you money, as long as you pay me back.
You can use my laptop, provided you don't download anything.
mistakes: As long as you'll be honest → As long as you are honest

rules.note: Suppose you won the lottery
ex: Supposing you had to choose — which would you pick?
What if nobody comes? What should we do?

rules.note: Only when I left did I realise. Only then did he understand.
ex: Only when you experience it can you truly understand.
Only after years of practice did she master the skill.
mistakes: Only after years of practice, she mastered → ... did she master

rules.note: So great was his relief that he wept. Such was her talent...
ex: So rapid was the change that nobody could adapt.
Such was her talent that she was offered a scholarship.
mistakes: So great his relief was that → So great was his relief
Such great was her talent → Such was her talent / So great was her talent

rules.note: Prices appear to be rising. This tends to occur when...
ex: The results appear to suggest a correlation.
Companies tend to underestimate implementation costs.
mistakes: Prices appear rising → Prices appear to be rising
Results seem suggest → Results seem to suggest

rules.note: Furthermore, Nevertheless, Conversely, In light of, With regard to
ex: The experiment failed. Nevertheless, the findings were instructive.
Furthermore, the data suggests a strong correlation.

rules.note: I would like to enquire... vs I'd like to ask... vs Can I ask...
ex: Formal: I wish to draw your attention to a discrepancy.
Neutral: I want to point out a mistake.
Informal: Just wanted to flag something up.
She is slim. (+) / She is thin. (0) / She is skinny. (-)

rules.note: "We shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the landing grounds..."
conduct research, draw conclusions, reach a consensus, address an issue
ex: Researchers conducted extensive interviews.
The committee failed to reach a consensus.
mistakes: make research → conduct/carry out research
do a conclusion → draw/reach a conclusion

Little friends → Few friends — countable.

mistakes: The reason because → The reason why / that / for which.
The day when we met on → The day (when) we met.

rules.note: The company for which / the person to whom
mistakes: The company which I work → The company which I work for / for which I work.
The issue about that we talked → The issue (which/that) we talked about.
A man tall and dark → A tall, dark man.
The girl her hair is long → The girl whose hair is long.
The problems which are discussed → The problems discussed.
Letters to posting → Letters to post / to be posted.

rules.note: Leaving the room, she… / Not knowing what to do…
mistakes: Walking home, the rain started. → While I was walking home, the rain started. — dangling participle.
Being tired, the bed looked inviting. → Being tired, I found the bed inviting.
Not knowing the answer, the teacher explained. → Not knowing the answer, I asked the teacher.
Finished the work, he went home. → Having finished the work, he went home.
Being arrived, we had dinner. → Having arrived, we had dinner.
She washed herself and dressed herself. → She washed and dressed.
I and my friend saw us in the mirror. → My friend and I saw ourselves in the mirror.
They talked themselves. → They talked to each other.

rules.note: One as a pronoun / general pronoun / one another
mistakes: Give me the blue ones book. → Give me the blue one.
They helped themselves one to another. → They helped one another / each other.

rules.note: I think so / I hope so / so they say
mistakes: I hope no. → I hope not.

rules.note: She did so immediately. Such was his anger.
mistakes: He asked me to leave and I did it so. → …and I did so.
It was such nice day. → It was such a nice day. — such a + sing. count.

mistakes: I can swim and he can too swim. → …and so can he.
I'm tired. Me too am. → I'm tired. So am I / Me too.

rules.note: I'd like to come if I can.
mistakes: He told me do it. → He told me to do it. — tell + to-inf.
The afraid child → The frightened child.
An asleep baby → A sleeping baby.
Very delicious → Absolutely delicious. — non-gradable.
Absolutely good → Very good. — gradable.
Very impossible → Completely impossible.
Very unique → Quite unique / unique. — unique non-gradable.

mistakes: The film was bored. → The film was boring.

rules.note: Eager to learn / capable of doing / certain that
mistakes: Capable to swim → Capable of swimming. — capable + of + -ing.
Interested to music → Interested in music.
Afraid to spiders → Afraid of spiders.

rules.note: He spoke loudly. He is a loud speaker.
mistakes: He speaks good English well. → He speaks English well.
More good → Better.

rules.note: Than expected / as planned / as good as it gets
mistakes: He is taller than me tall. → He is taller than I am / than me.
As soon as possible as → As soon as possible.
More expensive as → More expensive than.
She speaks always loudly. → She always speaks loudly.
He goes usually to work by bus. → He usually goes to work by bus.
He drives quickly always. → He always drives quickly.

rules.note: Here/there/away; often/frequently; recently/soon
mistakes: Recently I have see him. → Recently I have seen him / I have seen him recently.

rules.note: very / extremely / even / just / only / almost
mistakes: He is very asleep. → He is fast / sound asleep.

rules.note: Obviously / personally / frankly / unfortunately
mistakes: Personal, I think so. → Personally, I think so.
Obvious, he is right. → Obviously, he is right.

rules.note: When / as soon as / once / until / by the time
mistakes: I'll call you when I will arrive. → …when I arrive.
Until you won't finish → Until you finish.
By the time he will come → By the time he comes.

rules.note: As / because / since / for / with
mistakes: Because of he was late → Because he was late / Because of his lateness.
With her smart, she succeeded. → With her being smart / Being smart, she succeeded.

rules.note: She left in order to avoid argument.
mistakes: For not being late → In order not to be late / So as not to be late.

rules.note: Although / even though / while / whereas / despite
mistakes: Despite of the rain → Despite the rain / In spite of the rain.
Whereas he is tall, his brother short. → Whereas he is tall, his brother is short.
If I will have time, I'll call. → If I have time, I'll call.
If he comes, I tell him. → …I'll tell him.
If I would be rich → If I were rich. — Type 2.
If I would have known → If I had known.
I would passed if I had studied. → I would have passed if I had studied.
Imagine he was here. → Imagine he were here. — subjunctive.

rules.note: Unless it rains / I don't know whether
mistakes: I don't know if or not he will come. → I don't know whether or not he will come.
Whether you like, tell me. → Whether you like it or not, tell me.

rules.note: However / therefore / moreover / in contrast
mistakes: It rained, however we went out. → It rained; however, we went out.
Therefore of the rain → Because of the rain / Therefore, we stayed in.
In contrary → On the contrary / In contrast.

rules.note: Along / across / past / through
mistakes: Walk across the forest → Walk through the forest.
Swim through the river → Swim across the river.

rules.note: Between two / among many
mistakes: Divide among the two of them → Divide between the two of them.
Among you and me → Between you and me.

rules.note: At noon / by then / over the years / throughout
mistakes: Finish until Friday. → Finish by Friday.
In Monday → On Monday.

rules.note: Except / except for / apart from / but
mistakes: Everyone except of Tom → Everyone except (for) Tom.

It was decided he to go. → It was decided that he should go.

rules.note: It seems / It appears / It turns out
mistakes: It seems he to be late. → He seems to be late / It seems he is late.
It turns that he lied. → It turns out that he lied.

rules.note: Cleft sentences: What I need is… / It was Tom who…
mistakes: It was Tom that did broke it. → It was Tom who broke it.

rules.note: Never have I seen / Only then did I realise
mistakes: Never I have seen such a thing. → Never have I seen such a thing.
Only then I realised. → Only then did I realise.

rules.note: Such was / So great was / Hardly had I…
mistakes: No sooner he had left when it rained. → No sooner had he left than it rained.

chapters.title: 基本句型与 be 动词
chapters.explanation:
## 英语的基本句型

英语句子由主语(谁/什么)和谓语(做什么/是什么)构成。最常用的三种基本句型:

1. **主系表**:主语 + be动词 + 表语。be 动词(am/is/are)是系动词,后面跟名词或形容词,表示"是什么/怎么样"。
2. **主谓宾**:主语 + 动词 + 宾语。表示"做了什么"。
3. **There be**:There is/are + 名词 + 地点。表示"某处有某物"。

## be 动词的三种形式

| 主语 | be 动词 |
|---|---|
| I | am |
| he / she / it / 单数名词 | is |
| we / you / they / 复数名词 | are |

否定式:在 be 后面加 not,如 is not = isn't。
疑问式:把 be 提到主语前面,如 Is he a student?

examples.en: I am a student.
examples.cn: 我是一名学生。
examples.note: 主系表:I 是主语,am 是 be 动词,a student 是表语。

examples.en: She is very kind.
examples.cn: 她非常友善。
examples.note: 表语也可以是形容词 kind。

examples.en: We are from China.
examples.cn: 我们来自中国。
examples.note: 主语是复数 we,be 用 are。

examples.en: There is a book on the desk.
examples.cn: 桌上有一本书。
examples.note: There be 句型表示"存在"。

errors.wrong: I is a student.
errors.right: I am a student.
errors.note: I 永远搭配 am,不能用 is。

errors.wrong: He are my brother.
errors.right: He is my brother.
errors.note: 第三人称单数用 is,不是 are。

errors.wrong: There have a book on the desk.
errors.right: There is a book on the desk.
errors.note: "有"要用 There be,不能用 have 直接替换。

chapters.title: 一般现在时
chapters.explanation:
## 一般现在时的用法

一般现在时表示经常发生的动作、习惯或客观事实。它有三种常见用法:

1. **经常性动作**:常与 always、usually、often、sometimes、never 等频度副词连用。
2. **客观事实与真理**:如太阳东升西落、水沸腾等,任何时候都对。
3. **现在的状态**:如 I am a student.

## 动词形式

| 主语 | 动词形式 |
|---|---|
| I / we / you / they / 复数 | 动词原形 |
| he / she / it / 单数 | 动词原形加 -s 或 -es |

第三人称单数变化规则:一般加 -s(like→likes);以 -s、-x、-ch、-sh、-o 结尾加 -es(go→goes);辅音字母加 y 结尾,变 y 为 i 加 -es(study→studies)。

## 否定与疑问

- 否定:主语 + don't / doesn't + 动词原形
- 疑问:Do / Does + 主语 + 动词原形?

注意:助动词 does 出现后,后面的动词必须用原形。

examples.en: I get up at seven every day.
examples.cn: 我每天七点起床。
examples.note: 经常性动作,主语 I 用动词原形 get。

examples.en: She likes music very much.
examples.cn: 她非常喜欢音乐。
examples.note: 第三人称单数 she,like 加 -s 变成 likes。

examples.en: Water boils at 100 degrees.
examples.cn: 水在 100 度沸腾。
examples.note: 客观真理用一般现在时,boil 加 -s。

examples.en: He doesn't watch TV on weekdays.
examples.cn: 他工作日不看电视。
examples.note: 否定用 doesn't + 动词原形 watch。

errors.right: She likes music.
errors.note: 第三人称单数主语后,动词必须加 -s。

errors.right: He doesn't like coffee.
errors.note: 第三人称单数的否定用 doesn't,不用 don't。

errors.note: 助动词 does 出现后,动词要恢复原形 like。

chapters.title: 一般过去时
chapters.explanation:
## 一般过去时的用法

一般过去时表示过去某个时间发生的动作或存在的状态。常与 yesterday、last week、ago、just now 等过去时间词连用。

## 动词过去式变化

1. **规则变化**:一般在动词后加 -ed(visit→visited);以 -e 结尾加 -d(live→lived);辅音字母加 y 结尾,变 y 为 i 加 -ed(study→studied)。
2. **不规则变化**:需要单独记忆,如 go→went、have→had、see→saw、eat→ate、come→came、make→made、take→took。
3. **be 动词**:am/is 的过去式是 was,are 的过去式是 were。

## 时间标志词

看到这些词一般就用一般过去时:yesterday(昨天)、last week / month / year(上周/月/年)、... ago(…以前)、just now(刚才)、in 2020(在 2020 年)。

## 否定与疑问

- 否定:主语 + didn't + 动词原形
- 疑问:Did + 主语 + 动词原形?

注意:didn't 和 Did 后面动词一律用原形,即使主语是第三人称单数。

examples.en: I visited my grandparents last weekend.
examples.cn: 我上周末看望了祖父母。
examples.note: visited 是 visit 的过去式,规则变化加 -ed。

chapters.title: 一般将来时
chapters.explanation:
## 一般将来时的用法

一般将来时表示将来要发生的动作或状态。常与 tomorrow、next week、soon、in the future 等时间词连用。有两种主要表达方式:

## 1. will + 动词原形

- 表示说话时临时作出的决定、主观意愿或对将来的预测。
- 否定:will not(won't)+ 动词原形;疑问:把 will 提到句首。
- 注意:will 后面永远用动词原形,不随主语变化。

## 2. be going to + 动词原形

- 表示事先计划好的打算,或根据现有迹象作出的预测(如乌云密布将要下雨)。
- 否定:be not going to;疑问:把 be 动词提前。

## 用法对比

| 情况 | 用 will | 用 be going to |
|---|---|---|
| 临时决定 | ✅ 电话响了"我去接" | ❌ |
| 事先计划 | ❌ | ✅ 周末野餐 |
| 有迹象预测 | ❌ | ✅ 乌云预示下雨 |
| 无依据的猜测 | ✅ I think... | ❌ |

examples.en: We will visit Beijing next month.
examples.cn: 我们下个月将去北京。

examples.en: I am going to study English tonight.
examples.cn: 我打算今晚学英语。
examples.note: 事先计划用 be going to,be 随主语变化为 am。

examples.cn: 很快就要下雨了。
examples.note: 根据迹象(乌云)预测,用 be going to。

examples.en: Will you come to my party?
examples.cn: 你会来我的聚会吗?
examples.note: 疑问句把 will 提前,后面用动词原形 come。

errors.right: She will come tomorrow.
errors.note: will 后面动词必须用原形 come。

errors.wrong: I going to buy a book tomorrow.
errors.right: I am going to buy a book tomorrow.
errors.note: be going to 结构不能省略 be 动词 am。

chapters.title: 冠词与名词复数
chapters.explanation:
## 冠词

1. **不定冠词 a / an**:表示"一个"、泛指。**a 用于辅音音素开头**(a book);**an 用于元音音素开头**(an apple)。注意看发音而不是字母:an hour(h 不发音)、a university(读作 ju:n 开头)。
2. **定冠词 the**:表示特指。用于上文提到过的人或物、双方都知道的事物、世界上独一无二的事物(the sun、the moon)。

## 名词复数

| 情况 | 变化 | 例词 |
|---|---|---|
| 一般情况 | 加 -s | book→books |
| -s / -x / -ch / -sh 结尾 | 加 -es | box→boxes |
| 辅音字母 + y 结尾 | 变 y 为 i 加 -es | city→cities |
| -f / -fe 结尾 | 变 f 为 v 加 -es | knife→knives |
| 少数不规则 | 特殊变化 | man→men, child→children |

examples.en: I have an apple and a banana.
examples.cn: 我有一个苹果和一根香蕉。
examples.note: apple 以元音音素开头用 an,banana 用 a。

examples.cn: 太阳从东方升起。

examples.cn: 书架上有许多书。

errors.note: knife 以 -fe 结尾,复数变 f 为 v 加 -es。

chapters.explanation:
## 人称代词

人称代词有**主格**和**宾格**两种形式:

| 主格 | I | you | he | she | it | we | they |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 宾格 | me | you | him | her | it | us | them |

- **主格**作主语(动作的发出者):She likes me.
- **宾格**作宾语(动作的承受者),放在动词或介词后:Please help him.

## 物主代词

| 类别 | 单数 | 复数 |
|---|---|---|
| 形容词性(my, your, his, her, its) | 后必须接名词:my book | our, your, their 同理 |
| 名词性(mine, yours, his, hers, its) | 单独使用:This is mine | ours, yours, theirs 同理 |

形容词性物主代词后面一定有名词;名词性物主代词相当于"形容词性 + 名词",后面不接名词。

chapters.title: 形容词与副词基础
chapters.explanation:
## 形容词与副词的职责

- **形容词**修饰名词,说明人或物的特征:beautiful girl、big house。位置在名词前,或放在 be 动词后作表语(She is happy.)。
- **副词**修饰动词、形容词或另一个副词:run quickly、very beautiful。说明动作的方式、程度或时间。

## 副词的形成

- 大多数副词由形容词加 -ly 构成:quick→quickly、careful→carefully。
- 注意特殊形式:good 的副词是 **well**(She sings well.),fast 既是形容词也是副词。

## 常见位置

| 修饰对象 | 位置 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| 动词 | 动词后 | He works hard. |
| 形容词 | 形容词前 | It is very cold. |
| be 动词后 | 表语 | The room is clean. |

chapters.title: 情态动词入门
chapters.explanation:
## 情态动词的特点

情态动词(can、must、should)用来表达能力、必要性和建议。它们有三个共同特点:

1. **后面接动词原形**,不加 -s、-ed,也不加 to。
2. **不随主语变化**:I can / He can 都是 can。
3. 否定直接加 not:**can't、mustn't、shouldn't**;疑问句把情态动词提到句首。

## 三个情态动词的用法

| 情态动词 | 含义 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| can | 能力、许可 | I can swim. / Can I...? |
| must | 必须(语气强) | You must be quiet. |
| should | 应该(建议) | You should rest. |

- **mustn't** 表示"禁止",而不是"不必"。
- **can 的过去式 could** 语气更委婉,常用来礼貌地请求:Could you help me?

examples.note: can 表示能力,后接动词原形 swim。

chapters.title: 进行时(现在/过去进行时)
chapters.explanation:
## 现在进行时

**构成:am / is / are + 动词 -ing**

表示说话时正在进行的动作,常与 now、look、listen、at the moment 等连用。

- Look! They are playing football.
- 注意:like、love、want、know 等**状态动词**一般不用进行时。

## 过去进行时

**构成:was / were + 动词 -ing**

表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作,常与 at eight last night、at that time 等连用,也常与 when / while 引导的时间状语从句配合。

## 用法对比

| 场景 | 用进行时 | 用一般时 |
|---|---|---|
| 此刻正在做 | I am reading. | ❌ |
| 经常习惯 | ❌ | I read every day. |
| 过去某刻正在做 | I was reading at 8. | ❌ |

口诀:进行时是"正在进行"的画面,一般时是"经常发生"的习惯。

chapters.title: 现在完成时
chapters.explanation:
## 现在完成时的构成

**have / has + 过去分词**

主语是第三人称单数用 has,其余用 have。规则动词的过去分词与过去式相同(加 -ed);不规则动词需要记忆:go→gone、see→seen、eat→eaten、come→come。

## 两种核心用法

1. **过去动作影响现在**:动作发生在过去,结果或影响持续到现在。I have lost my key.(现在进不了门)
2. **从过去持续到现在**:与 since + 时间点、for + 时间段连用。She has lived here for five years.

## 标志词

| 标志词 | 用法 |
|---|---|
| already | 肯定句,"已经" |
| yet | 否定句和疑问句,句末 |
| just / ever / never | 刚才 / 曾经 / 从不 |
| since / for | 持续到现在 |

注意:yesterday、last week 等过去时间词不能与完成时连用,只能用一般过去时。

examples.cn: 我已经完成作业了。

chapters.title: 过去完成时(入门)
chapters.explanation:
## 过去完成时的构成

**had + 过去分词**(所有人称都用 had)

## 核心概念:过去的过去

过去完成时表示**在过去的某个时间之前**已经完成的动作。先发生的动作用过去完成时,后发生的用一般过去时。

- When I arrived, the train had left. 我到达时,火车已经开走了。(leave 先于 arrive)

## 常见搭配

| 句型 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| By the time + 一般过去时,主句 + had done | 到…时候已经 |
| Before / After + 一般过去时 | 在…之前/之后 |
| 主句(一般过去时)+ 宾语从句(过去完成时) | 过去的过去 |

## 与现在完成时的区别

现在完成时以"现在"为参照点;过去完成时以"过去"为参照点。因此主句是过去时(如 said、told、got)时,从句用过去完成时。

examples.en: By the time I got there, the train had left.
examples.cn: 我到那里时,火车已经开走了。
examples.note: got there 是过去,left 发生在它之前,用过去完成时。

examples.en: She had finished her homework before dinner.
examples.cn: 她在晚饭前已完成了作业。
examples.note: 以 dinner 为过去参照点,finish 发生得更早。

examples.en: He told me he had seen the movie.
examples.cn: 他告诉我他已看过这部电影。
examples.note: told 是过去,see 发生在 told 之前,用 had seen。

examples.en: When I woke up, my mother had already gone to work.
examples.cn: 我醒来时,妈妈已经上班去了。
examples.note: woke up 是过去参照点,go 发生得更早。

errors.wrong: I had saw the movie before.

chapters.title: 不定式 to do
chapters.explanation:
## 不定式的构成

**to + 动词原形**,如 to go、to learn。它兼具名词、形容词和副词的某些作用,可以在句中作主语、宾语和目的状语。

## 主要用法

1. **作宾语**:部分动词后只能接不定式。常见的有 want、decide、hope、plan、would like、learn、agree 等。
   - I want to learn English.
2. **作目的状语**:表示"为了"。
   - He got up early to catch the bus.
3. **作主语**:常用 it 作形式主语,真正的主语放后面。
   - It is important to keep healthy.

## 特殊结构

| 结构 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| too + 形容词 + to do | 太…而不能 |
| 形容词 + enough + to do | 足够…去做 |

注意:to 后面永远是动词原形,不能再加 -ing。

examples.en: I want to learn English well.
examples.cn: 我想学好英语。
examples.note: want 后接不定式 to learn 作宾语。

examples.en: He went to the station to catch the train.
examples.cn: 他去车站赶火车。
examples.note: to catch 作目的状语,表示"为了"。

examples.en: It is important to keep healthy.
examples.cn: 保持健康很重要。
examples.note: it 是形式主语,真正主语是 to keep healthy。

examples.en: The box is too heavy to carry.
examples.cn: 这箱子太重了搬不动。
examples.note: too...to 表示"太…而不能"。

errors.wrong: I decide go there alone.
errors.right: I decide to go there alone.
errors.note: decide 后必须接不定式 to go。

errors.wrong: She wants to going shopping.
errors.right: She wants to go shopping.
errors.note: to 后接动词原形 go,不能写 going。

errors.wrong: He is too young to driving.
errors.right: He is too young to drive.
errors.note: too...to 结构中介词后是动词原形 drive。

chapters.title: 动名词 doing
chapters.explanation:
## 动名词的构成与作用

**动词 + -ing**(如 reading),兼具动词和名词的性质。动名词可以作**主语**和**宾语**。

- 作主语:Swimming is good for health.(谓语用单数)
- 作宾语:I enjoy reading.

## 只接动名词的常见动词

enjoy、finish、practice、keep、mind、suggest、avoid 等动词后**只能**接动名词,不能接不定式。

- I finished doing my homework.

## 介词后的动名词

介词(at、in、for、of 等)后面要接名词或动名词:

- be good at playing basketball
- be interested in dancing
- thanks for helping me

## 易混点:stop 的两种搭配

- **stop to do** 停下来去做另一件事(目的)
- **stop doing** 停止正在做的事

另外还有 go + doing 的固定搭配:go shopping、go swimming。

examples.en: I enjoy reading books.
examples.cn: 我喜欢读书。
examples.note: enjoy 后接动名词 reading。

examples.en: He is good at playing basketball.
examples.cn: 他擅长打篮球。
examples.note: 介词 at 后接动名词 playing。

examples.en: Swimming is good for health.
examples.cn: 游泳对健康有好处。
examples.note: 动名词作主语,谓语动词用单数 is。

examples.en: She went shopping with her mother.
examples.cn: 她和妈妈去购物了。
examples.note: go + doing 是固定搭配。

errors.wrong: I enjoy to read novels.
errors.right: I enjoy reading novels.
errors.note: enjoy 后接动名词,不接不定式。

errors.wrong: He finished to do his work.
errors.right: He finished doing his work.
errors.note: finish 后接动名词 doing。

errors.wrong: Thanks for help me.
errors.right: Thanks for helping me.
errors.note: 介词 for 后接动名词 helping。

chapters.title: 被动语态
chapters.explanation:
## 被动语态的构成

**be + 过去分词**(done)

当我们强调动作的承受者,或不关心动作的执行者时,用被动语态。

## 常见时态的被动形式

| 时态 | 被动形式 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| 一般现在时 | am / is / are + done | The room is cleaned every day. |
| 一般过去时 | was / were + done | The bridge was built in 2010. |
| 一般将来时 | will be + done | The work will be finished tomorrow. |
| 情态动词 | can / must + be + done | It must be done at once. |

## 主动改被动的方法

1. 宾语提前作主语;
2. 谓语动词变为 be + 过去分词(be 随新主语和时态变化);
3. 原主语用 by 引出,不必要时可以省略。

注意:**不及物动词**(如 happen、take place、appear)没有被动语态,也不能用被动。

examples.en: The room is cleaned every day.
examples.cn: 房间每天被打扫。
examples.note: 一般现在时被动,is + 过去分词 cleaned。

examples.en: The bridge was built in 2010.
examples.cn: 这座桥建于 2010 年。
examples.note: 一般过去时被动,was + 过去分词 built。

examples.cn: 全世界都说英语。
examples.note: 不强调施动者时用被动语态。

examples.cn: 这项工作明天将完成。
examples.note: 一般将来时被动,will be + 过去分词。

errors.right: The window was broken yesterday.
errors.note: 被动语态用过去分词 broken。

errors.note: write 的过去分词是 written,不是 wrote。

errors.right: The meeting happened yesterday.

The letter is written in French.

Three people were injured in the accident.

The letter has wrote. → The letter has been written. — Perfect Passive: has been + V3 .

It said that… → It is said that… .

chapters.title: 定语从句(who/which/that)
chapters.explanation:
## 定语从句的概念

定语从句修饰名词或代词,这个被修饰的词叫**先行词**,从句紧跟其后。

The man who is talking to our teacher is my uncle.

## 关系代词的选择

| 关系代词 | 指代 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| who | 人(作主语或宾语) | The girl who wears a red coat is my sister. |
| which | 物(作主语或宾语) | The book which I bought is interesting. |
| that | 人或物均可 | The house that stands there is new. |
| whose | 表示"…的" | I know the boy whose father is a doctor. |

## 注意事项

1. 关系代词在从句中**作主语**时不能省略;作宾语时可省略(This is the book (that) I bought.)。
2. 从句中不再出现多余的主语或宾语,避免重复。
3. 指人用 who/that,指物用 which/that,两者大多可互换。

examples.en: The man who is talking to our teacher is my uncle.
examples.cn: 正在和我们老师说话的那个人是我叔叔。
examples.note: who 指人 the man,在从句中作主语。

examples.en: The book that I bought yesterday is interesting.
examples.cn: 我昨天买的那本书很有趣。
examples.note: that 指物,作 bought 的宾语。

examples.en: This is the house which was built in 1990.
examples.cn: 这是 1990 年建的房子。
examples.note: which 指物 the house,在从句中作主语。

examples.en: The girl who wears a red coat is my sister.
examples.cn: 穿红外套的女孩是我妹妹。
examples.note: who 指人,在从句中作主语,不可省略。

errors.wrong: The man which is standing there is my teacher.
errors.right: The man who is standing there is my teacher.
errors.note: 指人用 who,不用 which。

errors.wrong: This is the book who I like.
errors.right: This is the book which / that I like.
errors.note: 指物用 which 或 that。

errors.wrong: The woman who she is singing is famous.
errors.right: The woman who is singing is famous.
errors.note: 从句中已有 who 作主语,不能再加 she。

the man whose car / the woman whom I met
mistakes: The man who's car is red → the man whose car is red — who's = who is.

mistakes: Give me the blue ones book. → Give me the blue one.
They helped themselves one to another. → They helped one another / each other.

It was such nice day. → It was such a nice day. — such a + sing. count.

chapters.title: 比较级与最高级
chapters.explanation:
## 比较级与最高级

- **比较级**用于两者之间的比较,句中常出现 than(比)。
- **最高级**用于三者或三者以上的比较,形容词最高级前通常加 the,后接 in / of 表示范围。

## 规则变化

| 情况 | 比较级 | 最高级 |
|---|---|---|
| 一般单词 | tall→taller | tallest |
| 以 -e 结尾 | nice→nicer | nicest |
| 辅音字母 + y | heavy→heavier | heaviest |
| 重读闭音节 | big→bigger | biggest |
| 多音节词 | interesting→more interesting | most interesting |

## 不规则变化

| 原级 | 比较级 | 最高级 |
|---|---|---|
| good / well | better | best |
| bad / badly | worse | worst |
| many / much | more | most |
| little | less | least |

同级比较用 as...as(和…一样),否定式 not as / so...as。

examples.en: This book is more interesting than that one.
examples.cn: 这本书比那本更有趣。
examples.note: 多音节词用 more + 原级构成比较级。

examples.en: She is the tallest girl in her class.
examples.cn: 她是班里最高的女孩。
examples.note: 最高级前加 the,用 in 表示范围。

examples.en: My bag is heavier than yours.
examples.cn: 我的包比你的重。
examples.note: heavy 辅音加 y,变 y 为 i 加 -er。

examples.en: He runs as fast as his brother.
examples.cn: 他跑得和他哥哥一样快。
examples.note: as...as 表示同级比较,中间用原级。

errors.wrong: He is more taller than me.
errors.right: He is taller than me.
errors.note: 比较级不能重复表达,不能 more 和 -er 同时用。

errors.wrong: She is the better student in her class.
errors.right: She is the best student in her class.
errors.note: 全班范围内用最高级 best,不用比较级。

errors.wrong: His English is gooder than mine.
errors.right: His English is better than mine.
errors.note: good 的比较级是不规则形式 better。

chapters.title: 情态动词推测(may/might/could)
chapters.explanation:
## 情态动词表推测

情态动词不仅可以表达能力、义务,还可以表达对情况的**推测**。可能性从高到低排列:

| 情态动词 | 含义 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| must | 一定(把握极大) | He must be at home. |
| may | 可能(不太确定) | He may be at home. |
| might | 也许(可能性更小) | He might come tonight. |
| could | 可能(委婉、不确定) | It could rain. |

## 否定与过去推测

- **否定推测**用 can't(不可能):That can't be Mary. 注意不能用 mustn't(mustn't 表示"禁止")。
- **对过去的推测**:may / might / could / must + have + 过去分词:He may have missed the train.

口诀:must 很肯定,can't 不可能,may/might/could 是"也许"。

examples.en: He may be at home now.
examples.cn: 他现在可能在家。
examples.note: may 表推测,语气较弱,后接动词原形 be。

examples.en: She might come to the party tonight.
examples.cn: 她今晚也许来参加聚会。
examples.note: might 语气更委婉,可能性更小。

examples.en: The light is on. He must be in the room.
examples.cn: 灯亮着,他一定在房间里。
examples.note: 有依据的肯定推测用 must。

examples.en: It can't be true.
examples.cn: 这不可能是真的。
examples.note: 否定推测用 can't,表示"不可能"。

errors.wrong: She might can come tomorrow.
errors.right: She might come tomorrow.
errors.note: might 后不能再用 can,情态动词不连用。

errors.wrong: He mustn't be at school because I saw him at home.
errors.right: He can't be at school because I saw him at home.
errors.note: 否定推测用 can't;mustn't 只表示禁止。

errors.wrong: He may has left.
errors.right: He may have left.
errors.note: 对过去的推测用 may + have + 过去分词。

chapters.title: 连词与状语从句(and/but/so/because/although)
chapters.explanation:
## 并列连词

| 连词 | 含义 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| and | 并列、递进("和") | I like tea and she likes coffee. |
| but | 转折("但是") | He is poor, but he is happy. |
| so | 结果("所以") | It rained, so we stayed home. |
| or | 选择、否则 | Hurry up, or you will be late. |

## 从属连词与状语从句

- **because**(因为):引导原因状语从句,回答 why。
- **although / though**(虽然):引导让步状语从句,表示"尽管"。

## 两条铁律

1. **because 和 so 不能同时使用**:Because he was ill, he didn't come.(或 He was ill, so he didn't come.)
2. **although 和 but 不能同时使用**:Although it was late, he kept working.(不能说 although...but...)

原则:一山不容二虎,引导词和连接词只能留一个。

examples.en: I like tea and my sister likes coffee.
examples.cn: 我喜欢茶,我妹妹喜欢咖啡。
examples.note: and 连接两个并列分句。

examples.en: He is poor, but he is happy.
examples.cn: 他穷,但他很快乐。
examples.note: but 表转折,前后意思相反。

examples.en: It was raining, so we stayed at home.
examples.cn: 下雨了,所以我们待在家。
examples.note: so 引出结果。

examples.en: Although it was cold, he went swimming.
examples.cn: 尽管天冷,他还是去游泳了。
examples.note: although 引导让步从句,主句不用 but。

errors.wrong: Because he was ill, so he didn't come.
errors.right: Because he was ill, he didn't come.
errors.note: because 和 so 不能同时出现在一个句子里。

errors.wrong: Although it was late, but he kept working.
errors.right: Although it was late, he kept working.
errors.note: although 与 but 不能同时使用。

errors.wrong: He studies hard, but he will pass the exam.
errors.right: He studies hard, so he will pass the exam.
errors.note: 努力是考试通过的原因,应用 so 表结果。

chapters.title: will 与 be going to
chapters.explanation:
## 两种将来表达

**will + 动词原形**与 **be going to + 动词原形**都表示将来,但侧重点不同:

| 情况 | will | be going to |
|---|---|---|
| 临时决定 | ✅ 电话响了"我去接" | ❌ |
| 事先计划 | ❌ | ✅ 周日野餐 |
| 有迹象的预测 | ❌ | ✅ 乌云要下雨 |
| 无依据的推测 | ✅ I think it will... | ❌ |

## 形式变化

- will 不随主语变化,否定 won't,疑问把 will 提前。
- be going to 中的 be 随主语变化(am / is / are),否定是 be not going to。

## 判断技巧

- 句中有 I think、probably、maybe 时多用 will;
- 看到具体迹象(look at the clouds!)或"已经安排好"的计划时用 be going to;
- 说话瞬间才作出的决定,用 will。

examples.en: I will answer the phone.
examples.cn: 我来接电话。
examples.note: 听到铃声临时决定,用 will。

examples.en: We are going to have a picnic this Sunday.
examples.cn: 我们这个星期天打算去野餐。
examples.note: 事先计划好的安排,用 be going to。

examples.en: Look at those dark clouds. It is going to rain.
examples.cn: 看那些乌云,要下雨了。
examples.note: 有迹象的预测用 be going to。

examples.en: I think she will pass the exam.
examples.cn: 我认为她会通过考试。
examples.note: 无具体依据的主观判断,用 will。

errors.wrong: He will going to Beijing tomorrow.
errors.right: He will go to Beijing tomorrow.
errors.note: will 后接动词原形 go,不能写 going。

errors.wrong: Look at the sky. It will rain.
errors.right: Look at the sky. It is going to rain.
errors.note: 有具体迹象的预测用 be going to。

errors.wrong: I will to open the window.
errors.right: I will open the window.
errors.note: will 后直接接动词原形,不加 to。

chapters.title: 介词基础
chapters.explanation:
## 时间介词 at / in / on

| 介词 | 用法 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| at | 具体时刻、年龄 | at 7 o'clock、at noon、at night |
| in | 月份、年份、季节、泛指的早中晚 | in May、in 2026、in the morning |
| on | 具体某一天、星期、日期 | on Monday、on May 1st、on Monday morning |

## 地点介词 at / in / on

- **in** 表示在内部、大地方:in China、in the room
- **on** 表示在表面:on the desk
- **at** 表示在具体小地点:at the bus stop

## 方位介词

in front of(前面)、behind(后面)、next to(旁边)、between...and(两者之间)、near(附近)、under(正下方)。

## 固定搭配

be good at(擅长)、look at(看)、listen to(听)、wait for(等待)、arrive in/at(到达)、depend on(依靠)。介词搭配没有万能规律,要在阅读中积累。

chapters.title: if 条件句
chapters.explanation:
## if 条件句的三种类型

if 条件句分为真实条件句与虚拟条件句两大类,关键在于**条件实现的可能性**。

## 真实条件句(现实可能实现)

- **零条件句**:if + 一般现在时,主句用一般现在时,表示普遍真理或习惯,如 If you heat ice, it melts。
- **第一条件句**:if + 一般现在时,主句用 will,表示将来很可能发生的事,如 If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home。注意:if 从句里永远不用 will,主句才用。

## 虚拟条件句(与事实相反)

- **第二条件句(与现在相反)**:if + 过去时(be 一律用 were),主句用 would/could/might + do,如 If I were you, I would study harder。
- **第三条件句(与过去相反)**:if + 过去完成时,主句用 would have done,如 If you had arrived earlier, you would have caught the train。

## 实用技巧

if 可以省略:当从句含 were/had/should 时,可倒装为 Were I you... / Had I known...。写作中要分清条件与主句的时态配对,这是六级考试高频考点。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
examples.cn: 如果明天下雨,我们就取消野餐。
examples.note: 第一条件句:if 从句用一般现在时 rains,主句用 will。

examples.en: If I were you, I would take that opportunity.
examples.cn: 如果我是你,我就会抓住那个机会。
examples.note: 第二条件句:与现在事实相反,be 动词一律用 were。

examples.en: If you had prepared earlier, you would have passed the exam.
examples.cn: 如果你早做准备,你早就通过考试了。
examples.note: 第三条件句:与过去事实相反,从句过去完成,主句 would have done。

examples.en: Had I known the answer, I would have told you.
examples.cn: 要是我知道答案,我早就告诉你了。
examples.note: 省略 if 的倒装结构:Had 提前,从句主语后置。

errors.right: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
errors.note: if 条件从句中不用 will,用一般现在时表将来。

errors.right: If I were you, I would apologize.
errors.note: 虚拟条件句中 be 动词一律用 were,不用 was。

errors.right: If he had come earlier, he would have seen her.
errors.note: 与过去相反时,主句要用 would have done,与从句时态配对。

chapters.title: wish 虚拟语气
chapters.explanation:
## wish 的虚拟用法

wish 后接宾语从句时,表示与现实相反、无法实现的愿望,从句必须用虚拟语气。关键是**把握从句的时态回落**。

## 三种时间对应

1. **对现在的愿望**:wish + 过去时(be 用 were),如 I wish I were rich。表示"现在没有钱"的遗憾。
2. **对过去的愿望**:wish + 过去完成时,如 I wish I had studied harder。表示"过去没做到"的后悔。
3. **对将来的愿望**:wish + would/could + 动词原形,如 I wish you would stop smoking。表示对将来难以改变的期待。

## 辨析与替换

- wish 侧重"难以实现的愿望",hope 侧重"可能实现的希望",hope 后不用虚拟语气。
- 与 if only 相同:If only I had known! 相当于 I wish I had known。
- 写作加分句:If only 开头的感叹句比 I wish 更有力,常用于道歉与复盘场景。

## 常考陷阱

wish 本身用过去时(wished)时,从句时态还要再回落一层:He wished he had come earlier(他当时后悔没早点来)。翻译时注意区分"希望"与"但愿"的语气。

examples.cn: 我真希望我现在是一名医生。
examples.note: 对现在的愿望,be 动词用 were。

examples.cn: 她后悔自己浪费了时间。
examples.note: 对过去的后悔,用过去完成时。

examples.cn: 我真希望你不再抱怨。

examples.cn: 要是当初听了你的建议就好了!
examples.note: If only 与 wish 同义,表达强烈的后悔。

errors.note: hope 表示可能实现的希望,不用虚拟语气。

chapters.title: 非谓语作定语
chapters.explanation:
## 三种非谓语作定语

doing、done、to do 都能放在名词后作定语,选择哪种取决于**主动/被动**与**时间**两个维度。

## 现在分词 doing(主动、进行)

表示"正在进行的主动动作",如 the boy playing basketball(正在打篮球的男孩)。单个分词也可放名词前:a developing country(发展中国家)。

## 过去分词 done(被动、完成)

表示"被动的或已完成的动作",如 the letter written in English(用英语写的信)、a developed country(发达国家)。注意区分:the falling leaves(正在飘落的叶子)vs the fallen leaves(已经落下的叶子)。

## 不定式 to do(将来、目的)

表示"将要发生的动作"或"该做的事",常与 the first/last/only、序数词、被修饰词的搭配词连用:the first person to arrive(第一个到的人)、something to drink(可以喝的东西)。

## 与定语从句的转换

doing 定语 = that/which + 主动进行;done 定语 = that/which + 被动;to do 定语 = that/which will。写作中学会三者互换,可有效避免句式重复。

examples.en: The girl singing on the stage is my sister.
examples.cn: 在台上唱歌的女孩是我妹妹。
examples.note: singing 表主动、正在进行,相当于 who is singing。

examples.en: The bridge built last year is very modern.
examples.cn: 去年建的那座桥非常现代化。
examples.note: built 表被动、完成,相当于 which was built。

examples.cn: 他是最后一个离开教室的学生。
examples.note: the last + to do,表示"最后一个做某事的人"。

examples.cn: 有很多问题需要解决。
examples.note: to do 作定语表将来,隐含"将要/需要"之意。

errors.note: 窗户是"被打破"的,要用过去分词 broken,不是主动的 breaking。

errors.right: The man speaking to the teacher is our principal.

chapters.title: 非谓语作状语
chapters.explanation:
## 非谓语作状语的三种形式

分词(doing/done)与不定式(to do)都可以作状语,用来表示时间、原因、条件、结果、方式、目的等,作用是**让句子更简洁**。

## 现在分词 doing(主动)

表示与主语构成主动关系:表伴随/方式,如 He sat there reading a book(他坐在那里看书);表原因,如 Being tired, I went to bed early(因为累了,我早早上床);表时间,如 Hearing the news, she cried(听到消息,她哭了)。

## 过去分词 done(被动)

表示与主语构成被动关系:如 Given more time, we can finish it(如果给更多时间,我们能完成);Seen from the hill, the city looks beautiful(从山上看,城市很美)。注意分词逻辑主语必须是句子的主语。

## 不定式 to do(目的、结果)

表目的:He worked hard to support his family;表出乎意料的结果:He rushed to school only to find it closed。

## 易错点

1. 分词与主语不匹配会产生"悬垂分词",如 Walking in the park, the flowers were beautiful(错误,花不会走路)。
2. 表目的要用 to do,表原因优先用分词。

examples.en: Hearing the good news, they jumped with joy.
examples.cn: 听到这个好消息,他们高兴得跳了起来。
examples.note: 现在分词表时间,相当于 When they heard...

examples.en: Given more time, I could have done it better.
examples.cn: 如果时间再多一点,我本可以做得更好。
examples.note: 过去分词表条件,given 含有被动意味。

examples.en: He worked day and night to earn more money.
examples.cn: 他日夜工作以赚更多的钱。
examples.note: 不定式表目的,意为"为了"。

examples.en: She ran all the way, her heart beating fast.
examples.cn: 她一路跑着,心跳得很快。
examples.note: her heart beating 是独立主格结构,保证逻辑主语一致。

errors.right: Walking in the park, I saw beautiful flowers.
errors.note: 悬垂分词:分词的逻辑主语必须是句子主语。

errors.note: 表原因用分词 Being,不用 to do。

errors.right: Seen from the hill, the city looks beautiful.
errors.note: seen 的逻辑主语是 city,不能是 we。

chapters.title: 名词性从句
chapters.explanation:
## 名词性从句:在句子中当"名词"用

名词能做什么成分,从句就能做什么成分。名词性从句分为三类:主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句(以及同位语从句)。

## 主语从句(从句作主语)

- That 从句:That she passed the exam surprised everyone。
- 为了防止头重脚轻,常用 it 作形式主语:It is important that we stay calm。
- 疑问词引导:Whether we go depends on the weather;What you said is right。注意:whether 能引导主语从句,if 不能。

## 宾语从句(从句作宾语)

- 动词后:He said (that) he would come,从句陈述句时 that 可省略。
- 介词后:We are talking about how to solve it。
- 形容词后:I am sure that he will win。

## 表语从句(从句作表语)

连系动词后:The reason is that he was ill;That is why I left early。注意 reason 与 that 搭配,不用 because。

## 三大易错

1. 语序必须为陈述语序:I don't know where he lives(不是 where does he live)。
2. 时态呼应:主句过去时,从句随之调整。
3. that 引导主语从句不省略,引导宾语从句可省略。

examples.en: That he finished the task alone surprised us all.
examples.cn: 他独自完成了任务,这让我们都很惊讶。
examples.note: That 引导主语从句,that 不能省略。

examples.en: It is obvious that practice makes perfect.
examples.cn: 很明显,熟能生巧。
examples.note: it 作形式主语,真正主语是后面的 that 从句。

examples.en: I wonder whether he will accept the offer.
examples.cn: 我想知道他是否会接受这个提议。
examples.note: whether 引导宾语从句,表达"是否"。

examples.en: The reason is that he missed the train.
examples.cn: 原因是他在错过火车。
examples.note: 表语从句用 that 引导,reason 后不用 because。

errors.right: I don't know where he lives.
errors.note: 宾语从句必须用陈述语序。

errors.right: Whether he will come is still unknown.
errors.note: 主语从句用 whether,不用 if。
