chapters.title: 倒装句
chapters.explanation:
## 倒装句:把谓语提到主语前

英语句子的常规语序是"主 + 谓",把谓语(或助动词)提到主语前,就构成倒装。倒装分两类:**全部倒装**(整个谓语提前)和**部分倒装**(助动词/情态动词提前)。

## 部分倒装的触发词

1. **否定词放句首**:never, hardly, seldom, not only, no sooner...than 等。Never have I seen such a view(我从未见过这样的景色)。
2. **Only + 状语放句首**:Only in this way can we succeed。
3. **So/Neither/Nor 表"也"**:He likes coffee, so do I;She can't swim, neither can I。

## 全部倒装

1. **here/there 开头的方位词**:Here comes the bus(车来了);There goes the bell(铃响了)。
2. **介词短语/副词放句首**:On the top of the hill stands an old temple。

## 高频考点

1. 倒装句中助动词时态要与原句一致:Hardly had I left when it rained(注意 had 提前,主句用过去完成)。
2. not only...but also 连接主语时不倒装:Not only he but also I am wrong。
3. so 用于"确实如此"时不倒装:He is clever, so he is(他确实很聪明)。

examples.en: Never have I met such a kind person.
examples.cn: 我从未遇到过这么善良的人。
examples.note: 否定词 Never 放句首,助动词 have 提前,部分倒装。

examples.en: Only after the storm did the sky clear.
examples.cn: 风暴过后天空才放晴。
examples.note: Only + 状语放句首,助动词 did 提前。

examples.en: Here comes the teacher.
examples.cn: 老师来了。
examples.note: here 放句首,全部倒装,主语 the teacher 后置。

examples.en: She can dance, and so can her sister.
examples.cn: 她会跳舞,她妹妹也会。
examples.note: so + 助动词 + 主语,表"也如此"。

errors.wrong: Never I have seen such a movie.
errors.right: Never have I seen such a movie.
errors.note: 否定词放句首必须部分倒装,助动词提前。

errors.wrong: Only by working hard we can succeed.
errors.right: Only by working hard can we succeed.
errors.note: Only + 状语放句首,情态动词 can 要提前。

errors.wrong: Here the bus comes.
errors.right: Here comes the bus.
errors.note: here 放句首时全部倒装,谓语 comes 提前。

chapters.title: 强调句
chapters.explanation:
## 强调句:It is/was + 被强调部分 + that + 其余

强调句用于突出句子的某个成分(主语、宾语、状语),结构为 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其他部分。去掉 It is...that 后句子仍然完整,这是判断强调句的黄金法则。

## 基本用法

原句:Tom met Mary in the park yesterday。

- 强调主语:It was Tom that (who) met Mary in the park yesterday。
- 强调宾语:It was Mary that Tom met in the park yesterday。
- 强调地点状语:It was in the park that Tom met Mary yesterday。
- 强调时间状语:It was yesterday that Tom met Mary in the park。

## 与定语从句的区别

It is the book that I bought yesterday(定语从句,book 在从句中作宾语)vs It was the book that I bought yesterday?去掉 It is...that 后,"the book I bought"不完整,这是定语从句。强调句去掉框架后句子仍完整。

## 特殊强调

1. 强调 not...until 结构:It was not until midnight that he came back。
2. 强调句型与疑问句结合:Was it you that broke the window?Who was it that called?

examples.en: It was in 2018 that he graduated from college.
examples.cn: 他是在 2018 年从大学毕业的。
examples.note: 强调时间状语 in 2018,去掉 It was...that 句子仍完整。

examples.en: It is the teacher who always encourages us.
examples.cn: 正是这位老师一直在鼓励我们。
examples.note: 强调人时可用 who 代替 that。

examples.en: It was not until midnight that he finished work.
examples.cn: 直到午夜他才完成工作。
examples.note: 强调 not...until 结构,固定搭配 It was not until...that。

examples.en: It is English that he studies at school.
examples.cn: 他在学校学的是英语。
examples.note: 强调宾语 English,去掉框架后 he studies English at school。

errors.wrong: It was yesterday when he came back.
errors.right: It was yesterday that he came back.
errors.note: 强调句中固定用 that,不用 when。

errors.wrong: It is because he is ill so he is absent.
errors.right: It is because he is ill that he is absent.
errors.note: 强调原因状语用 that,不用 so。

errors.wrong: It was at the station which he saw the accident.
errors.right: It was at the station that he saw the accident.
errors.note: 强调地点状语固定用 that,不用 which。

external.text: It-cleft: It was John who called.
ex: It is hard work that leads to success.

external.text: Wh-cleft: What surprised me was the price.
external.note: What I need is rest. What she said shocked everyone.
ex: What I love about London is the diversity.
What he did was completely unexpected.

chapters.title: 分词作状语
chapters.explanation:
## 分词作状语:动作的"旁白"

现在分词(doing)与过去分词(done)都可作状语,表达时间、原因、条件、让步、方式、伴随等关系。核心是**判断与主语的逻辑关系**:主动用 doing,被动用 done。

## 现在分词作状语(主动)

- 表时间:Hearing the alarm, he jumped up(听到警报,他跳了起来)。
- 表原因:Being late, she missed the bus(因为迟到,她错过了公交车)。
- 表伴随:He walked away, whistling a song(他哼着歌走开了)。

## 过去分词作状语(被动)

- 表条件:Given another chance, he would do better(再给一次机会,他会做得更好)。
- 表原因:Encouraged by the teacher, he tried again(受到老师鼓励,他又试了一次)。
- 表时间:Finished, the report was sent to the boss(完成后,报告被送给了老板)。

## 完成式与独立主格

- Having done 强调动作先发生:Having finished dinner, they went out。
- 独立主格解决主语不一致:Time permitting, we'll stay(名词/代词 + 分词)。

## 三大易错

1. 分词逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致。
2. 被动关系误用 doing:被鼓励要说 Encouraged,不说 Encouraging。
3. 表目的不用分词,用 to do。

examples.en: Seeing the police, the thief ran away.
examples.cn: 看到警察,小偷逃跑了。
examples.note: 现在分词表时间,thief 是 seeing 的逻辑主语。

examples.en: Surprised by the news, she couldn't speak.
examples.cn: 被这个消息震惊,她说不出话来。
examples.note: 过去分词表原因,she 是被震惊的对象。

examples.en: Having finished the task, he went home.
examples.cn: 完成任务后,他回家了。
examples.note: Having done 强调动作先于主句动作完成。

examples.en: Weather permitting, we will go boating.
examples.cn: 如果天气允许,我们就去划船。
examples.note: 独立主格:名词 weather + 分词 permitting。

errors.wrong: Encouraging by his words, she kept going.
errors.right: Encouraged by his words, she kept going.
errors.note: she 是被鼓励的对象,要用过去分词 Encouraged。

errors.wrong: Looking from the top, the park is beautiful.
errors.right: Looked from the top, the park is beautiful.
errors.note: 这里逻辑主语是 park,公园是被看的,用 Looked。

errors.wrong: To see the accident, he called 911.
errors.right: Seeing the accident, he called 911.
errors.note: 表原因/时间用分词,to do 只表目的。

chapters.title: 时态综合
chapters.explanation:
## 时态综合:一个句子里的时间轴

六级考试常在一个句子里综合考察多种时态。关键是**先定位时间参照点,再选时态**。

## 核心时态一览

1. **现在完成进行时 have/has been doing**:从过去一直持续到现在、可能还在继续的动作,如 I have been studying English for ten years(我学英语十年了,可能还在学)。
2. **过去完成进行时 had been doing**:过去某时之前一直在进行的动作。
3. **将来完成时 will have done**:将来某时之前将已完成,如 By next month, I will have finished the project。
4. **现在完成时 have done 与过去时的区别**:强调结果与现在联系 vs 单纯过去事实。I have lost my key(现在没有钥匙)vs I lost my key yesterday。

## 时间标志词

- 现在完成:since, for, so far, recently, already
- 完成进行:for + 时间段, since, all day
- 将来完成:by + 将来时间, by the time

## 时态呼应

主句用过去时,从句也须过去时态系列;主句现在时,从句按需自由。It was said that he had gone abroad。

## 易错点

1. since 从句用过去时,主句用现在完成时:I have lived here since I was a child。
2. by the time + 过去时,主句用过去完成时。

examples.en: I have been reading this novel for three days.
examples.cn: 这本小说我已经读了三天了。
examples.note: 现在完成进行时,强调动作持续且可能仍在进行。

examples.en: By the end of this year, we will have built the bridge.
examples.cn: 到今年年底,我们将建成这座桥。
examples.note: 将来完成时,by + 将来时间标志。

examples.en: She had been working in the company for five years before she quit.
examples.cn: 辞职前,她在那家公司已经工作了五年。
examples.note: 过去完成进行时,强调过去的持续。

examples.en: It is the third time he has made the same mistake.
examples.cn: 这是他第三次犯同样的错误。
examples.note: It is the first/second/third time + 现在完成时。

errors.wrong: I am living here since 2015.
errors.right: I have been living here since 2015.
errors.note: since 引导的时间段用完成时态,不用现在进行时。

errors.wrong: By the time he arrived, the meeting started.
errors.right: By the time he arrived, the meeting had started.
errors.note: by the time + 过去时,主句用过去完成时。

errors.wrong: I have seen the movie last night.
errors.right: I saw the movie last night.
errors.note: 有明确的过去时间 last night,用一般过去时。

chapters.title: 短语动词
chapters.explanation:
## 短语动词:动词 + 介词/副词

短语动词由动词加一个小品词(介词或副词)构成,整体意思往往不能从字面猜出。它是六级完形与翻译的高频考点。

## 常见类型

1. **动词 + 介词**(后必接宾语):look after(照顾), depend on(依靠), deal with(处理)。
2. **动词 + 副词**(可分可合):turn on/off, put on, give up。宾语是代词时**必须放中间**:turn it on, give it up,不能说 turn on it。
3. **动词 + 副词 + 介词**:look forward to(期待), come up with(想出), put up with(忍受)。注意 look forward to 后接 doing。
4. **动词 + 介词 + 名词**:take care of(照顾), pay attention to(注意)。

## 一词多义

get 类短语:get up(起床), get over(克服), get along with(相处), get rid of(摆脱), get through(通过)。take 类:take off(起飞/脱下), take up(占据/从事), take over(接管), take after(像)。

## 学习策略

1. 按动词归类记忆,一组一组背。
2. 关注及物性:介词短语后必接宾语,副词短语宾语可前可后。
3. 完形中注意动词与介词搭配的固定性:prevent...from, spend...on, accuse...of。

examples.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
examples.cn: 离开时请关灯。
examples.note: turn off 是"动词+副词",宾语 the lights 可放中间。

examples.en: This problem is hard to deal with.
examples.cn: 这个问题很难处理。
examples.note: deal with 是"动词+介词",必须连在一起后接宾语。

examples.en: I am looking forward to meeting you soon.
examples.cn: 我期待着早日见到你。
examples.note: look forward to 中的 to 是介词,后接 doing。

examples.en: It took him years to get over the failure.
examples.cn: 他花了好几年才从失败中走出来。
examples.note: get over 表示"克服,从……恢复"。

errors.wrong: Please turn on it.
errors.right: Please turn it on.
errors.note: 代词宾语必须放在"动词+副词"中间。

errors.wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
errors.right: I look forward to hearing from you.
errors.note: to 是介词,后接动名词 hearing。

errors.wrong: She takes after of her mother.
errors.right: She takes after her mother.
errors.note: take after(像)是"动词+介词"结构,不加 of。

external.note: turn on/off, put on/take off, get up
mistakes: I put on my coat on → I put on my coat / I put my coat on .
Take off them → Take them off .

external.note: break down, carry on, find out, look forward to
mistakes: find out the truth out → find out the truth / find the truth out .

external.note: get up / turn on / look after
fill in / give out / find out / break in
mistakes: find out it → find it out .

external.note: carry out / sort out / turn out / wear out
mistakes: run out milk → run out of milk — of.
turn out that to be → turn out to be .

external.note: put on / take off / set off / call off
mistakes: set off to the trip → set off on the trip — on.

external.note: fall off / get on / switch off / run off
mistakes: get in the bus → get on the bus — on.
get on a taxi → get in a taxi — in.
switch off it → switch it off .

external.note: grow up / break down / slow down / set up
pick up / give up / make up / keep up
mistakes: pick up it → pick it up .
keep up from me → keep up with me — with.

external.note: turn up / show up / come up with / look up
mistakes: come up an idea → come up with an idea — with.
look up it → look it up .

external.note: go away / throw away / come back / look back
mistakes: throw away it → throw it away .

chapters.title: 介词进阶
chapters.explanation:
## 介词进阶:一词多义的精确把握

介词是英语的"胶水"。六级阶段要掌握介词的**多重含义**与**固定搭配**。

## 常用介词的多义

1. **for**:表目的(为)、时间持续(for three years)、原因(be famous for)、交换(buy for)。
2. **with**:表伴随(with a book)、方式(with care)、原因(tremble with fear)、带有(a man with glasses)。
3. **on**:在……上、关于(a book on history)、从事(on duty)、依靠(depend on)。
4. **in**:时间(in the morning)、地点、状态(in trouble)、方式(in English)、将来(in a week)。

## 固定搭配精讲

- 形容词 + 介词:good at, interested in, proud of, worried about, familiar with, different from。
- 动词 + 介词:congratulate sb on, prevent sb from, accuse sb of, warn sb of。
- 名词 + 介词:reason for, effect on, access to, solution to, attitude toward。

## 易混介词

- between(两者)vs among(三者以上)
- since(点时间)vs for(段时间)
- in(一段时间内)vs after(从说话时刻起)
- 注意 the key to the door 用 to,不用 of;the answer to the question 同理。

examples.en: She is familiar with the local customs.
examples.cn: 她熟悉当地的风俗。
examples.note: familiar with 表"熟悉"。

examples.en: The key to success is persistence.
examples.cn: 成功的关键是坚持。
examples.note: key 后用介词 to,固定搭配。

examples.en: He prevented me from making the same mistake.
examples.cn: 他阻止我犯同样的错误。
examples.note: prevent sb from doing 固定结构。

examples.en: The meeting will be held in three days.
examples.cn: 会议将在三天后举行。
examples.note: in + 时间段表将来,意为"……之后"。

errors.wrong: She is good in math.
errors.right: She is good at math.
errors.note: be good at 是固定搭配,表"擅长"。

errors.wrong: He is proud for his son.
errors.right: He is proud of his son.
errors.note: be proud of 表"为……骄傲"。

errors.wrong: The door key is broken.
errors.right: The key to the door is broken.
errors.note: 口语可说 door key,但书面正式表达 key to the door 更规范。

chapters.title: 限定词与数量词
chapters.explanation:
## 限定词与数量词:名词前的"限定"艺术

限定词(determiner)用来限定名词的范围,数量词表达"多少"。二者决定名词前能不能加 a/an、用不用复数。

## 三类基本限定词

1. **冠词**:a/an(一个), the(特指)。
2. **物主/指示**:my, your, his... this, that, these, those。
3. **数量词**:some, any, many, much, few, little, several, enough。

## 可数 vs 不可数

- many + 可数复数 / much + 不可数:I have many books, but not much time。
- a few(几个,肯定)/ few(几乎没有,否定)+ 可数;a little(一点)/ little(几乎没有)+ 不可数。
- some 用于肯定句和邀请请求;any 用于否定和疑问。

## 数量结构

- 大量:a lot of / lots of / plenty of(可数不可数皆可);a large number of + 可数;a large amount of + 不可数。
- 少量:a bit of + 不可数;a couple of + 可数。

## 语序问题

限定词之间也有顺序:both my parents;all the students;half an hour。易错点:such a beautiful day(a 在 such 后),so beautiful a day(so 后)。

examples.en: There is little water in the bottle.
examples.cn: 瓶子里几乎没水了。
examples.note: little + 不可数 water,含否定意味"几乎没有"。

examples.en: A few students have passed the test.
examples.cn: 有几个学生通过了考试。
examples.note: a few + 可数复数,肯定意味"有几个"。

examples.en: I have plenty of time to prepare.
examples.cn: 我有充足的时间准备。
examples.note: plenty of 可修饰可数与不可数名词。

examples.en: Such an interesting story deserves sharing.
examples.cn: 这么有趣的故事值得分享。
examples.note: such + a/an + 形容词 + 名词的固定语序。

errors.wrong: I don't have many money.
errors.right: I don't have much money.
errors.note: money 不可数,用 much。

errors.wrong: There are a little books on the shelf.
errors.right: There are a few books on the shelf.
errors.note: books 可数复数,用 a few。

errors.wrong: He asked me some questions, but I couldn't answer any of them. (改为否定语气)
errors.right: He asked me some questions, and I answered a few of them.
errors.note: a few 表肯定"几个",few 表否定"几乎没几个"。

external.note: a friend of mine / one person I know
No solution / none of them / not any reason

mistakes: I have much friends. → I have many / a lot of friends. — countable.
Lots of informations → Lots of information. — uncountable.
Each of them know. → Each of them knows. — each sing.
All of information → All the information / all of the information.
Less people came. → Fewer people came. — countable.
A few water → A little water. — uncountable.
Little friends → Few friends — countable.

chapters.title: 长难句拆解法
chapters.explanation:
## 长难句拆解法:五步断句法

考研阅读和翻译的核心能力是拆解长难句。方法论:先找主干,再理修饰,层层剥离。

## 五步拆解流程

1. **找谓语动词**:一个简单句只有一个谓语,句子中谓语动词的数量 = 从句数量 + 1。先圈出所有谓语,再找出主句的那个。
2. **划主干**:主谓宾/主系表。先把从句和介词短语剔掉,剩下的就是骨架。
3. **找连词**:that, which, who, when, where, because, although 等引导从句,从句有自己的主谓。
4. **定位修饰成分**:定语修饰名词,状语修饰动作,插入语可整体忽略。
5. **重组翻译**:先译主干,再按中文习惯把修饰语安插回去。

## 实战要点

- 从句套从句时,由内向外拆,先译最内层。
- 非谓语(to do/doing/done)是隐形从句,补出逻辑主语再理解。
- 破折号和逗号之间的部分多为插入语,先跳过。
- 每拆完一层就问:谁?做了什么?对谁?在哪?何时?为什么?

## 训练建议

每天拆 3 个长难句,先英译中再回译,坚持一个月,阅读速度可提升一倍。

examples.en: The book that I bought yesterday, which cost me fifty yuan, is very useful.
examples.cn: 我昨天买的那本书,花了我五十元,非常有用。
examples.note: 主干 The book is useful;两个从句分别修饰 book。

examples.en: Despite the heavy rain, he managed to arrive on time, which surprised everyone.
examples.cn: 尽管下着大雨,他还是设法准时到达,这让所有人惊讶。
examples.note: 介词短语 Despite the heavy rain 是状语,which 从句修饰整件事。

examples.en: The reason why he failed the exam is that he didn't study hard enough.
examples.cn: 他考试失败的原因是他学习不够努力。
examples.note: why 定语从句 + that 表语从句,双从句嵌套。

examples.en: Having finished his work, he left the office, feeling satisfied with what he had done.
examples.cn: 完成工作后,他离开办公室,对自己做的事很满意。
examples.note: Having finished 和 feeling 都是非谓语,补出主语 he。

errors.wrong: 拆解时先翻译整个长句再找主干。
errors.right: 拆解时先找谓语和主干,再处理从句。
errors.note: 方法错误:正确顺序是先骨架后修饰,不要整体硬译。

errors.wrong: The man who I met yesterday who is a doctor is my neighbor.
errors.right: The man who I met yesterday is my neighbor, and he is a doctor.
errors.note: 原句两个 who 叠用造成结构混乱,应拆成两个清晰成分。

errors.wrong: 对长难句可以直接逐词直译。
errors.right: 对长难句应先调整语序再按中文逻辑翻译。
errors.note: 直译会导致欧化句式,须按中文习惯重组。

chapters.title: 从句嵌套
chapters.explanation:
## 从句嵌套:从句里套从句

考研长难句最典型的特征是**多层嵌套**:定语从句里套宾语从句,状语从句里套定语从句。拆解时坚持"从外到内逐层剥"。

## 三类嵌套结构

1. **定语从句 + 宾语从句**:The news that he told me that he had won made me happy。
2. **名词性从句内嵌定语**:What he said that impressed me most was his honesty。
3. **状语从句内嵌从句**:Although he knew that the task was hard, he decided to try。

## 拆解三原则

1. **先定主句**:主句的谓语往往只有一个,其余谓语都属于从句。
2. **连词成对匹配**:一个 that 引导一个从句,数清楚 that 的个数就知道有几层。
3. **先内后外**:翻译时先译最内层从句,再逐层向外。

## 高频考点

- 多重 that 引导时注意区分:引导定语从句的 that 作成分,引导名词性从句的 that 不作成分。
- what 引导主语从句等于"the thing that":What we need is time。
- 嵌套中插入语会打断语流,如 The fact, as we all know, that he won is true。

## 实战提示

真题中 60% 的长难句是"主句 + 定语从句 + 定语从句"或"主句 + 宾语从句 + 定语从句"模式,先记模式再实战。

examples.en: The fact that he didn't come to the meeting that we held yesterday surprised us.
examples.cn: 他没有来参加我们昨天举行的会议,这个事实让我们吃惊。
examples.note: that 同位语从句 + that 定语从句,双层嵌套。

examples.en: I believe that the plan which he proposed will work.
examples.cn: 我相信他提出的计划会奏效。
examples.note: 宾语从句里套定语从句:which 修饰 plan。

examples.en: What impressed the visitors most was the museum that they visited.
examples.cn: 让游客印象最深的是他们参观的那座博物馆。
examples.note: what 主语从句 + that 定语从句。

examples.en: Although he admitted that he had made mistakes, he refused to apologize.
examples.cn: 虽然他承认自己犯了错,却拒绝道歉。
examples.note: 让步状语从句里套宾语从句。

errors.wrong: The book that I bought that is interesting costs much.
errors.right: The book that I bought is interesting and costs much.
errors.note: 原句两个 that 堆叠且结构混乱,应合并成清晰的并列谓语。

errors.wrong: He said that he would come that he was free.
errors.right: He said that he would come if he was free.
errors.note: 第二个 that 语义不清,应换成条件连词 if。

errors.wrong: What he said that impressed me was true.
errors.right: What he said impressed me was true.
errors.note: what 已经包含先行词,不能再用 that 引导定语从句。

chapters.title: 非谓语综合与独立主格
chapters.explanation:
## 非谓语综合与独立主格

考研英语中非谓语出现的频率极高,且常与独立主格结合出现。**核心原则:句中不能同时出现两个无连词的谓语动词,多余的动词必须变为非谓语形式**。

## 非谓语三大形式回顾

1. **to do**:表目的、将来、某次具体动作。
2. **doing**:表主动、进行、伴随、原因。
3. **done**:表被动、完成。

## 独立主格结构

当非谓语的逻辑主语与主句主语不一致时,需要带出自己的逻辑主语,形成"名词/代词 + 分词/不定式/介词短语/形容词/副词"结构:

- Weather permitting, we will go out。(天气允许的话……)
- The meeting over, we left。(会议结束后……)
- He entered the room, book in hand。(他手里拿着书走进房间)

## 考研实战要点

1. 独立主格与 with 结构互换:with the work done / the work done。
2. 判断逻辑主语:分词前的名词是谁,逻辑主语就是谁。
3. 非谓语否定式:not 放在分词前面,如 Not having heard from him, she worried。
4. 独立主格作状语表时间/原因/条件/伴随,这是翻译得分点。

examples.en: The task finished, he went to bed.
examples.cn: 任务完成后,他去睡觉了。
examples.note: 独立主格:task 是 finished 的逻辑主语,表时间。

examples.en: With the guide leading, we explored the cave.
examples.cn: 在向导带领下,我们探索了洞穴。
examples.note: with + 名词 + 现在分词,表伴随。

examples.en: He was seen entering the building.
examples.cn: 有人看见他进入了大楼。
examples.note: 感官动词后的非谓语:主动进行用 doing。

examples.en: The project being discussed is of great importance.
examples.cn: 正在讨论的这个项目非常重要。
examples.note: 非谓语作定语:being done 表被动进行。

errors.wrong: He came in, his hands were shaking.
errors.right: He came in, his hands shaking.
errors.note: 两个谓语无连词连接,把后句改成独立主格。

errors.wrong: The report writing last night, she submitted it this morning.
errors.right: The report written last night, she submitted it this morning.
errors.note: 独立主格中 report 是被写的,要用过去分词 written。

errors.wrong: Known not where to go, he stopped at the corner.
errors.right: Not knowing where to go, he stopped at the corner.
errors.note: he 是主动"不知道",用 not knowing,且 not 位于分词之前。

chapters.title: 省略与指代
chapters.explanation:
## 省略与指代:读懂"留白"的艺术

考研阅读中,省略和指代是理解的关键。作者为了简洁常省略重复成分,并用代词指代前文。读不懂省略和指代,就抓不住句意。

## 常见省略

1. **并列省略**:He likes coffee and I (like) tea。省略重复的谓语动词。
2. **定语从句省略**:The man (whom) I met yesterday。关系代词作宾语可省略。
3. **状语从句省略**:When (I was) young, I lived here。从句主语与主句一致时可省略主谓。
4. **不定式省略**:He can run faster than I can (run)。
5. **so/not 替代**:I think so / I hope not。

## 指代关系

1. it/that 指代单数名词或上文整件事:He won, but nobody knew it。
2. they/them 指代复数名词:注意往前找最近的可数复数先行词。
3. one/ones 代替同类不同个:The red apple is sweeter than the green one。

## 考研实战

真题阅读理解几乎每题都有指代题(What does "it" refer to?)。解题要点:指代就近原则 + 单复数一致 + 语义通顺验证。翻译时把省略部分补全再译,译文要流畅自然。

examples.en: When in doubt, ask for help.
examples.cn: 有疑问时,就寻求帮助。
examples.note: 省略 When you are,补全为 When you are in doubt。

examples.en: He speaks French better than I do.
examples.cn: 他法语说得比我好。
examples.note: do 替代 speak French,避免重复。

examples.en: The car I bought is cheaper than the one she bought.
examples.cn: 我买的车比她买的便宜。
examples.note: one 代替 car,指代同类事物。

examples.en: Although tired, he kept working.
examples.cn: 虽然累了,他仍继续工作。
examples.note: 省略 Although he was,补全主语和 be 动词。

errors.wrong: I like tea, and she likes.
errors.right: I like tea, and she does too.
errors.note: 省略后用助动词替代,不能只留 likes。

errors.wrong: The man whom I saw him yesterday is my uncle.
errors.right: The man whom I saw yesterday is my uncle.
errors.note: 关系代词作宾语后不能再保留代词 him,或者直接省略 whom。

errors.wrong: He can swim faster than I can swim fast.
errors.right: He can swim faster than I can.
errors.note: 重复内容省略,只留情态动词。

chapters.title: 英译汉技巧
chapters.explanation:
## 英译汉技巧:从"欧化"到"地道"

考研翻译(英译汉)的得分要点是**忠实 + 通顺**。方法得当,可以快速提分。

## 五大核心技巧

1. **拆分法**:长句按从句和短语拆成短句,再组合。英文一句可含多个从句,中文要断成小句。
2. **语序调整**:英文状语后置、定语后置,中文习惯前置。The book written by him → 他写的书。
3. **词性转换**:名词转动词、介词转动词,如 His failure to come → 他没来。
4. **增词与减词**:英文抽象名词多,翻译时按中文习惯补充"问题、情况、方面"等范畴词。
5. **被动转主动**:英文多被动,中文多主动,如 It is said that → 据说。

## 四步翻译流程

1. 通读全句,找主干。2. 划分意群,逐块翻译。3. 按中文语序重组。4. 检查增删与通顺度。

## 高频采分点

定语从句的拆分、被动语态的处理、非谓语的补充翻译、it 形式主语的固定译法(It is important to... → 重要的是……)。

examples.en: It is important that we should protect the environment.
examples.cn: 保护环境很重要。
examples.note: it 形式主语译为"……很重要",去掉 it is。

examples.en: The problem discussed at the meeting yesterday was solved today.
examples.cn: 昨天会上讨论的问题今天解决了。
examples.note: 过去分词定语前置译,"昨天会上讨论的"。

examples.en: He was praised by the teacher for his honesty.
examples.cn: 他因为诚实受到了老师的表扬。
examples.note: 被动转主动或保留被动,按中文习惯处理。

examples.en: Only when we understand the past can we plan for the future.
examples.cn: 只有了解过去,我们才能规划未来。
examples.note: 倒装结构还原为正常语序再译,注意"只有……才……"。

errors.wrong: 直译:He is a good student who works hard. → 他是一个好的学生谁努力工作。
errors.right: 意译:他是个好学生,学习很努力。
errors.note: who 引导的定语从句拆分译成独立小句。

errors.wrong: 直译:It is known to all that... → 它被所有人知道。
errors.right: 意译:众所周知……
errors.note: it 固定结构用中文惯用表达。

errors.wrong: 逐词堆砌,不调整语序。
errors.right: 按中文语序重组意群。
errors.note: 逐词直译会产出不通顺的译文,必须先重组。

chapters.title: 阅读题型方法论
chapters.explanation:
## 阅读题型方法论:六类题型的破解逻辑

考研英语阅读(Text 1-4)题型固定,方法比盲目刷题更重要。先定位,再比对,最后排除。

## 六大题型与对策

1. **主旨题**(What is the passage mainly about?):看首段首尾句 + 各段主题句,选项要覆盖全文,以偏概全的排除。
2. **细节题**:回文定位,同义替换为正确答案,照抄原文的往往有陷阱。
3. **推断题**(It can be inferred that...):选项必须是原文信息的合理延伸,过度推断和绝对化(only, all, never)排除。
4. **词义题**(The word "..." is closest in meaning to...):回原文定位,看上下文逻辑(转折、因果、并列)猜词。
5. **态度题**:找作者评价性词汇(形容词、副词、情态动词),注意 I think, in my view 等。
6. **例证题**(The example is used to illustrate...):例子本身不重要,答案在例子前一句或后一句的观点句。

## 解题流程

1. 先读题干,划关键词。2. 回文定位到 1-2 句内。3. 对比选项与原文,找同义替换。4. 排除绝对化、无中生有、偷换概念的干扰项。

## 时间分配

每篇 15-18 分钟:通读 5 分钟 + 做题 10 分钟 + 检查 3 分钟。

examples.en: The main purpose of this passage is to call for public attention to the issue of plastic waste.
examples.cn: 本文的主要目的是呼吁公众关注塑料垃圾问题。
examples.note: 主旨题正确项常用 call for / emphasize 等高度概括词。

examples.en: It can be inferred from the passage that the author is worried about the future of traditional media.
examples.cn: 从文中可以推断,作者对传统媒体的未来感到担忧。
examples.note: 推断题答案来自观点与语气词,非原文直说。

examples.en: The word "paradox" in paragraph 2 probably means a situation that seems contradictory.
examples.cn: 第二段中 paradox 一词大概指看似矛盾的情况。
examples.note: 词义题结合上下文逻辑关系推断。

examples.en: The example of the successful startup is used to illustrate that innovation requires patience.
examples.cn: 成功创业公司的例子被用来证明创新需要耐心。
examples.note: 例证题答案在例子前后的观点句。

errors.wrong: 细节题选项与原文一字不差,直接选。
errors.right: 细节题找同义替换,照抄原文的选项往往是干扰项。
errors.note: 命题人常把原文词换个说法或加限定词制造陷阱。

errors.wrong: 推断题选绝对化表述:All scientists agree...
errors.right: 推断题排除绝对化表述,选合理延伸。
errors.note: only/all/never 等绝对词几乎都是干扰项。

errors.wrong: 主旨题选只概括第一段的选项。
errors.right: 主旨题选能覆盖全文中心的选项。
errors.note: 以偏概全的主旨选项是典型陷阱。

chapters.title: 完形与新题型技巧
chapters.explanation:
## 完形与新题型技巧:逻辑是灵魂

考研完形(20 空)和新题型(段落排序/填空/标题匹配)考察的核心是**篇章逻辑与词汇搭配**。

## 完形填空六大技巧

1. **先通读后作答**:先 2 分钟通读全文抓大意,切忌边读边选。
2. **逻辑关系词**:however(转折)、therefore(因果)、moreover(递进)、in addition(补充)是命题核心,前后文逻辑决定选项。
3. **词汇复现**:答案常是前文某词的近义、反义或原词复现。
4. **固定搭配优先**:如 pay attention to, take pride in, spend...on。
5. **语法线索**:时态、主谓一致、非谓语形式帮助锁定选项。
6. **概率均衡**:20 题答案分布较均匀,做完后检查 5 选 1 的分布。

## 新题型三类型

1. **七选五(填句)**:看空格前后句的指代、逻辑、时态衔接;选项首尾词是关键线索。
2. **段落排序**:找首段特征(引出话题、不含代词指代),再看指代衔接。
3. **标题匹配(小标题)**:每段首句 + 段内关键词,选高度概括项。

## 时间分配

完形 15 分钟,新题型 15-20 分钟,不要恋战,先易后难。

examples.en: He failed the exam, however, he didn't give up.
examples.cn: 他考试失败了,然而,他并没有放弃。
examples.note: however 表转折,前后语气相反。

examples.en: The weather was bad; therefore, the flight was delayed.
examples.cn: 天气不好,因此航班延误了。
examples.note: therefore 表因果,前因后果。

examples.en: In addition to English, she can speak French.
examples.cn: 除了英语,她还会说法语。
examples.note: in addition to 表补充,后接名词。

examples.en: The experiment failed again. Nevertheless, the team remained optimistic.
examples.cn: 实验再次失败。尽管如此,团队仍然乐观。
examples.note: nevertheless 表让步转折,连接正反信息。

errors.wrong: 完形填空边读边选,节省时间。
errors.right: 先通读全文把握大意,再回头作答。
errors.note: 没有整体语境,局部信息容易选错,通读反而更快。

errors.wrong: 七选五只看空格前一句就选。
errors.right: 结合空格前后句的指代和逻辑线索判断。
errors.note: 前后句的代词、连词、复现词都是重要线索。

errors.wrong: 新题型排序题先排中间段。
errors.right: 先找首段(通常引出话题、无指代),再顺藤摸瓜。
errors.note: 从首段入手,利用指代衔接逐步推进。

chapters.title: 考研作文句式
chapters.explanation:
## 考研作文句式:模板的"高级化"改造

考研大作文(图画/图表)与小作文(书信/通知)都靠句式得分。**评分标准看句式多样性**,高分关键是把常见表达升级。

## 八大必背句式

1. **引出图画**:As is vividly depicted in the picture, ...
2. **描述现象**:There is a growing tendency that... / An increasing number of people...
3. **引出观点**:From my perspective, ... / As far as I am concerned, ...
4. **举例论证**:Take... as an example; A case in point is...
5. **强调重要性**:It is of great importance to... / Nothing is more important than...
6. **表因果**:It is owing to... that... / Consequently, ...
7. **递进**:What's more / Moreover / Furthermore
8. **结尾总结**:In conclusion / To sum up / All in all, ...

## 句式升级四招

1. 简单句 → 复合句:用 which/that 从句合并。
2. 主动 → 被动:It should be noted that...
3. 加插入语:as we all know, in my view。
4. 用非谓语开头:Given the importance of..., ...

## 避坑要点

模板痕迹过重会扣分:不要整段背模板,要背句式骨架,填充自己的内容。语法错误最致命:写完必查主谓一致与时态。

examples.en: As is vividly depicted in the picture, a student is buried in his books.
examples.cn: 如图生动所示,一名学生埋头于书本之中。
examples.note: 图画描述万能开头句。

examples.en: It is of great significance to protect our environment.
examples.cn: 保护环境非常重要。
examples.note: be of + 抽象名词 = 形容词,高级表达。

examples.en: Nothing is more valuable than health.
examples.cn: 没有什么比健康更宝贵。
examples.note: Nothing is more... than... 最高级强调句式。

examples.en: Given the rapid development of technology, online learning is becoming popular.
examples.cn: 鉴于科技的快速发展,在线学习正变得流行。
examples.note: Given + 名词短语作状语,引出背景。

errors.wrong: 背诵整篇范文,考试直接默写。
errors.right: 背诵句式骨架,用自己的内容填充。
errors.note: 整篇照搬会被判模板化低分。

errors.wrong: This picture show that people like read books.
errors.right: This picture shows that people like reading books.
errors.note: 主谓一致 show→shows,like 后接动名词 reading。

errors.wrong: In my opinion, I think it is very important and necessary.
errors.right: In my opinion, it is of great importance.
errors.note: 去掉重复表达,用 of + 名词的高级结构。

chapters.title: 翻译实战
chapters.explanation:
## 翻译实战:五大失分点与应对

考研英译汉(5 句)考查词汇、语法、表达的综合能力。**得分=准确 + 完整 + 通顺**。

## 五大高频失分点

1. **词义选择错误**:一词多义须结合语境,如 address(地址/处理)、develop(发展/开发/冲洗)。
2. **结构理解错误**:从句边界划错,主谓配错,全句错译。
3. **漏译**:代词、情态动词、否定副词漏掉。
4. **硬译**:不按中文习惯调整语序,句子不通。
5. **术语不译**:学术概念要准确对应中文术语。

## 翻译四步法

1. 通读全句,确定主干。
2. 划分意群,逐块翻译(关键词要准)。
3. 重组语序,补充省略成分。
4. 通读检查,补漏改硬。

## 实战句型处理

- it 形式主语:It is necessary that → 有必要……
- 定语从句过长:拆成独立小句,重复先行词。
- 被动句:转主动或保留"被、由、为……所"。
- 双重否定:not...until → 直到……才;no...without → 没有……就没有。

## 时间策略

每句 5 分钟:理解 1 分钟 + 翻译 3 分钟 + 检查 1 分钟。

examples.en: It is essential that we take immediate action to solve the problem.
examples.cn: 我们必须立即采取行动解决这个问题。
examples.note: It is essential that 译为"必须/有必要"。

examples.en: The man who saved the child was praised by the whole town.
examples.cn: 救下那个孩子的人受到全镇的表扬。
examples.note: 定语从句前置译,"救下孩子的那个人"。

examples.en: He didn't realize the importance of health until he fell ill.
examples.cn: 他直到生病才意识到健康的重要性。
examples.note: not...until 译为"直到……才"。

examples.en: What we need most is a clear plan, not more promises.
examples.cn: 我们最需要的是一个清晰的计划,而不是更多的承诺。
examples.note: what 主语从句译为"我们所需要的是"。

errors.wrong: The plan was carried out successfully. → 计划被成功执行了。
errors.right: 该计划得以顺利实施。
errors.note: 中文不滥用"被"字,转主动或"得以/加以"更自然。

errors.wrong: He addressed the crowd. → 他给人群写了地址。
errors.right: 他向人群发表讲话。
errors.note: address 一词多义,此处是"演讲"。

errors.wrong: 直译 Every student has a dream. → 每一个学生都有一个梦想。(硬译)
errors.right: 每个学生都有自己的梦想。
errors.note: 按中文习惯调整,避免"一个"硬译。

chapters.title: 真题长难句精讲
chapters.explanation:
## 真题长难句精讲:经典结构逐句拆

考研真题阅读中的长难句有**固定套路**:主句 + 定语从句 + 状语从句 + 非谓语的组合。掌握经典结构,即可举一反三。

## 四大经典结构

1. **主句 + 双定语**:The book that he wrote, which was published in 2019, became a bestseller。
2. **not only...but also 倒装**:Not only did he finish the task, but also he did it perfectly。
3. **比较结构**:The more you practice, the better you become。
4. **插入语 + 从句**:The plan, as we all know, was made by the committee, which is highly experienced。

## 拆解示范

原句:But the more people join the course, the more effective it becomes, as everyone brings unique ideas to the discussion, which enriches the whole learning experience。

拆解步骤:
1. 主干是 the more...the more... 比较结构。
2. as 引导原因状语从句。
3. which 引导非限制性定语从句,修饰整个讨论。

译文:但参加课程的人越多,课程就越有效,因为每个人都为讨论带来独特的想法,这丰富了整个学习体验。

## 真题训练建议

每天精拆 1-2 句:抄写 → 划成分 → 翻译 → 对照译文 → 背诵。坚持一个月,长难句不再是障碍。

examples.en: The more books you read, the wider your horizon becomes.
examples.cn: 你读的书越多,你的视野就越开阔。
examples.note: the more...the more... 比较结构,前为条件后为结果。

examples.en: Not only did he apologize, but he also made up for the loss.
examples.cn: 他不仅道歉了,还弥补了损失。
examples.note: not only 放句首,前半句部分倒装。

examples.en: The theory, which was proposed by a young scientist, soon proved correct.
examples.cn: 这个由年轻科学家提出的理论很快被证明是正确的。
examples.note: 非限制性定语从句补充说明主语。

examples.en: It is the effort we put in, rather than the talent we have, that determines success.
examples.cn: 决定成功的是我们付出的努力,而非我们拥有的天赋。
examples.note: 强调句 + 定语从句 + rather than 对比结构。

errors.wrong: The more you read, the more knowledge you will get it.
errors.right: The more you read, the more knowledge you will get.
errors.note: get it 中 it 多余,knowledge 已是宾语。

errors.wrong: Not only he made a promise, but he kept it.
errors.right: Not only did he make a promise, but he kept it.
errors.note: not only 放句首须部分倒装,助动词 did 提前。

errors.wrong: The teacher, who is kind and patient, teach us English.
errors.right: The teacher, who is kind and patient, teaches us English.
errors.note: 主谓一致:主语 teacher 是单数,谓语用 teaches。

chapters.title: 学术写作句式
chapters.explanation:
## 学术写作句式:Task 2 高分句型库

雅思大作文要求 formal register(正式语体)。掌握学术句式,评分标准中 Grammatical Range and Accuracy 直接受益。

## 必备学术结构

1. **引出话题**:It is widely acknowledged that... / There is a growing body of evidence that...
2. **给出观点**:It is argued that... / I tend to believe that...
3. **让步反驳**:Although it is true that..., I would argue that...
4. **因果**:This is primarily because... / As a result, ...
5. **对比**:While A is..., B, by contrast, is...
6. **限定程度**:To a certain extent, ... / It is not entirely true that...

## 避免口语化

把 well, a lot, get, good 换成 significantly, a considerable amount, obtain, beneficial。用名词化(名词短语替代动词句)提升正式度:Students who are poor → Students' poverty。

## 平衡观点

- 开头段:Paraphrase 题目 + 表明立场。
- 主体段:Topic sentence + 论证 + 例子。
- 结尾段:Summarize + 重申立场(不引入新观点)。

examples.en: It is widely acknowledged that technology has transformed our daily lives.
examples.cn: 人们普遍认为,科技已经改变了我们的日常生活。
examples.note: It is widely acknowledged that 是学术开头标准句式。

examples.en: Although it is true that online learning is convenient, it cannot fully replace classroom interaction.
examples.cn: 虽然在线学习确实方便,但它不能完全取代课堂互动。
examples.note: although 让步 + 主句观点,体现思辨。

examples.en: The rapid development of artificial intelligence has raised serious concerns about employment.
examples.cn: 人工智能的快速发展引发了对就业问题的严重担忧。
examples.note: 名词化结构 the rapid development of... 提升正式度。

examples.en: This is primarily because most consumers prefer cheaper alternatives.
examples.cn: 这主要是因为大多数消费者偏爱更便宜的替代品。
examples.note: primarily because 提供精确的因果关系。

errors.wrong: I think technology is very good and it makes things a lot easier.
errors.right: It is widely acknowledged that technology has made tasks significantly easier.
errors.note: 正式语体替换口语表达,升级句式。

errors.wrong: First, pollution is bad. Second, pollution is dangerous.
errors.right: To begin with, pollution poses a serious threat to public health.
errors.note: 避免短句堆砌,用学术表达连贯论述。

errors.wrong: In conclusion, I want to say something new about the topic.
errors.right: In conclusion, I would like to restate my position.
errors.note: 结尾段不引入新观点,只总结重申。

chapters.title: 同义替换策略
chapters.explanation:
## 同义替换策略:雅思阅读的解题钥匙

雅思阅读 90% 的题考**同义替换(paraphrasing)**:题目与原文用不同词汇表达相同含义。识别替换,就能快速定位答案。

## 四大替换类型

1. **近义词替换**:原文 beneficial → 题目 advantageous;原文 expensive → costly。
2. **词性转换**:原文名词改为题目动词:He showed courage → He acted courageously。
3. **上下义词替换**:原文说 car,题目说 vehicle(上义词);原文说 vehicle,题目说 bus(下义词)。
4. **句式转换**:主动变被动、陈述变否定之否定、定语从句变分词。

## 实战定位法

- 题干关键词(名词优先)→ 回文扫读找同义表达,而非找原词。
- 数字、大写、时间词通常不替换,是定位锚点。
- 判断题注意程度替换:原文 often,题目 always 属于绝对化陷阱。

## 高频替换词对

increase/rise/grow/boost;decrease/decline/fall;important/crucial/vital/significant;cause/lead to/result in;show/indicate/demonstrate;need/require/demand。

examples.en: The government is taking measures to reduce pollution.
examples.cn: 政府正采取措施减少污染。
examples.note: reduce 可替换为 cut down on / lessen。

examples.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to heart health.
examples.cn: 经常锻炼对心脏健康有益。
examples.note: beneficial 替换为 advantageous / good for。

examples.en: The research indicates that sleep affects memory.
examples.cn: 研究表明睡眠影响记忆。
examples.note: indicate 替换为 show / suggest / demonstrate。

examples.en: A rise in temperature leads to the melting of glaciers.
examples.cn: 气温上升导致冰川融化。
examples.note: leads to 替换为 results in / causes。

errors.wrong: 题目关键词必须和原文单词完全一致才能定位。
errors.right: 定位靠同义替换,不找原词照搬。
errors.note: 雅思阅读的核心就是识别替换表达。

errors.wrong: 原文 often,判断题题目说 always 是正确的。
errors.right: often 与 always 程度不同,属于陷阱。
errors.note: 绝对化程度词替换是判断题常见陷阱。

errors.wrong: 替换只能换近义词。
errors.right: 词性转换、上下义词、句式转换都是替换。
errors.note: 同义替换有四种类型,远不止近义词。

chapters.title: 图表描述
chapters.explanation:
## 图表描述:Task 1 数据表达全攻略

雅思小作文 Task 1 需要**客观描述数据**,不发表观点。掌握趋势与比较的表达,直接对应 Lexical Resource 和 Grammatical Range。

## 趋势描述词汇

- **上升**:increase, rise, grow, climb, soar;副词:steadily, sharply, gradually。
- **下降**:decrease, decline, fall, drop, plunge;rapidly, slightly。
- **平稳**:remain stable, stay constant, level off, plateau。
- **波动**:fluctuate around, vary。

## 必备句式

1. 开头句:The line graph shows/charts/illustrates the changes in... over a period of...
2. 描述上升:The number of tourists increased dramatically from 1 million in 2000 to 3 million in 2010。
3. 描述峰谷:It reached a peak of... in...;It hit the lowest point at...
4. 对比:While A rose steadily, B remained relatively stable。

## 数据表达要点

- 时态看数据时期:过去数据用过去时,预测用将来时。
- 用介词 from...to..., by + 幅度:increased by 20%。
- 描述占比:accounted for, constituted, made up。
- 概括段:总结主要趋势,不逐点罗列。

examples.en: The graph illustrates the changes in mobile phone usage between 2010 and 2020.
examples.cn: 该图展示了 2010 至 2020 年间手机使用量的变化。
examples.note: 开头句标准句式:illustrate + changes in + 时间范围。

examples.en: The number of visitors increased dramatically from 2 million to 5 million.
examples.cn: 游客数量从 200 万急剧增加到 500 万。
examples.note: increase + from...to... 描述变化范围。

examples.en: The sales reached a peak of 10,000 units in March.
examples.cn: 三月份销售额达到 10000 台的峰值。
examples.note: reach a peak of 描述最高点。

examples.en: By contrast, the figure for exports remained relatively stable.
examples.cn: 相比之下,出口数据保持相对稳定。
examples.note: by contrast 引出对比,remain stable 描述平稳。

errors.wrong: The number increased a lot in 2015.
errors.right: The number increased sharply/rapidly in 2015.
errors.note: 用精确的程度副词替代笼统的 a lot。

errors.wrong: I think the increase is very good.
errors.right: The increase can be attributed to economic growth.
errors.note: Task 1 不发表个人观点,客观描述即可。

errors.wrong: The percentage of students rises 10%.
errors.right: The percentage of students rose by 10%.
errors.note: 用 by + 幅度,并注意时态与数据时期一致。

chapters.title: 观点论述框架
chapters.explanation:
## 观点论述框架:四段式高分结构

雅思大作文 Task 2 最常见的是四段式结构。**结构清晰是评分标准 Coherence and Cohesion 的得分关键**。

## 四段式框架

1. **开头段(2 句)**:Paraphrase 题目 + 表明立场(agree/disagree 或双边讨论)。
2. **主体段一(4-6 句)**:Topic sentence + 2 个论证 + 例子。
3. **主体段二(4-6 句)**:对比或补充另一面。
4. **结尾段(2 句)**:总结 + 重申立场。

## 论证方法

- **举例论证**:For instance, ...;A notable example is...
- **因果论证**:This is because...;Consequently, ...
- **对比论证**:By contrast, ...;On the other hand, ...
- **让步论证**:Admittedly, ...;However, ...

## 衔接词工具

- 递进:furthermore, moreover, in addition
- 转折:however, nevertheless, nonetheless
- 因果:therefore, as a result, thus
- 举例:for example, such as, namely
- 总结:in conclusion, to sum up, overall

## 立场一致性

开头定的立场,全文必须保持一致,不能首尾矛盾。每个主体段用 Topic sentence 开头,展开控制在 2-3 个论据。

examples.en: While some people believe that traditional classrooms are essential, I tend to argue that online learning is equally effective.
examples.cn: 虽然有人认为传统课堂必不可少,但我倾向于认为在线学习同样有效。
examples.note: 双边对比 + 明确立场的开头句。

examples.en: For instance, many companies now hire employees through online interviews.
examples.cn: 例如,许多公司现在通过线上面试招聘员工。
examples.note: For instance 引出具体例子支撑观点。

examples.en: Admittedly, face-to-face communication offers certain advantages; however, its cost is considerable.
examples.cn: 诚然,面对面交流有其优势;然而,其成本相当高。
examples.note: Admittedly 让步 + however 转折,体现思辨。

examples.en: In conclusion, although both approaches have merits, I firmly believe that a balanced combination works best.
examples.cn: 总之,尽管两种方式各有优点,我坚信平衡结合最佳。
examples.note: 结尾段总结并重申立场。

errors.wrong: 主体段没有 Topic sentence 直接列举例子。
errors.right: 主体段先用 Topic sentence 点明论点再展开。
errors.note: 主题句是段落中心,读者和考官都需要它。

errors.wrong: 开头说同意,结尾却说反对。
errors.right: 开头定的立场必须贯穿全文。
errors.note: 立场前后矛盾是 Task 2 严重失分点。

errors.wrong: 主体段写 8 个观点,蜻蜓点水。
errors.right: 每段集中论证 2-3 个论点,深入展开。
errors.note: 论证深度比观点数量更重要。

chapters.title: 学术词汇搭配
chapters.explanation:
## 学术词汇搭配:Collocation 决定地道度

雅思高分考生不靠生僻单词,靠**正确搭配(collocation)**。搭配错误会直接拉低 Lexical Resource 与口语的自然度。

## 高频学术搭配

1. **动词 + 名词**:conduct research(开展研究), draw a conclusion(得出结论), make progress(取得进步), pose a threat(构成威胁)。
2. **形容词 + 名词**:significant impact, considerable amount, growing concern, vital role。
3. **副词 + 形容词**:highly effective, widely accepted, increasingly popular, severely affected。
4. **介词搭配**:be capable of, be concerned about, depend on, benefit from, contribute to。

## 易错搭配警示

- do a research(错误)→ conduct/carry out research。
- make a conclusion(错误)→ draw/reach a conclusion。
- pay attention on(错误)→ pay attention to。

## 积累方法

1. 用搭配词典查词时看完整搭配,而非单个单词。
2. 按话题分类积累:环境、教育、科技、健康。
3. 口语写作中刻意使用 2-3 个高级搭配,提升表达层次。

examples.en: The government conducted a large-scale survey on public health.
examples.cn: 政府就公共卫生开展了一项大规模调查。
examples.note: conduct a survey 是标准学术搭配。

examples.en: Technology plays a vital role in modern education.
examples.cn: 科技在现代教育中起着至关重要的作用。
examples.note: play a vital role in 表"起重要作用"。

examples.en: This measure is highly effective in reducing pollution.
examples.cn: 这项措施在减少污染方面非常有效。
examples.note: highly + effective 是副词形容词搭配。

examples.en: Regular reading contributes to the improvement of writing skills.
examples.cn: 经常阅读有助于写作能力的提高。
examples.note: contribute to 表"有助于"。

errors.wrong: I need to do a research on this topic.
errors.right: I need to conduct research on this topic.
errors.note: research 与 conduct/carry out 搭配,不用 do。

errors.wrong: We can draw a conclusion that exercise is helpful.
errors.right: We can draw the conclusion that exercise is helpful.
errors.note: draw a/the conclusion 固定搭配,this 处应用定冠词 the。

errors.wrong: You should pay attention on your pronunciation.
errors.right: You should pay attention to your pronunciation.
errors.note: pay attention 后接 to,固定介词搭配。

chapters.title: 口语流利表达
chapters.explanation:
## 口语流利表达:Fluency 与 Coherence 双提升

雅思口语评分看流利度与连贯性。**流利不等于语速快**,而是自然、不间断、有逻辑。

## 口语工具箱

1. **话题开场**:Well, to be honest, ...;Actually, ...;That's an interesting question。
2. **争取时间**:Let me think about that for a second;That's a good question。
3. **展开论述**:First of all, ...;In addition, ...;Most importantly, ...
4. **举例**:For example, I remember...;A good case in point is...
5. **对比**:On the one hand..., on the other hand...
6. **总结**:So overall, ...;In a word, ...

## 流利技巧

1. 观点 + 原因 + 例子(PPP 法:Point, Reason, Example)。
2. 使用填充语保持语流,但要适度。
3. 用衔接词连接观点,避免"断片式"回答。
4. 宁可放慢语速说清楚,也不要赶速度出错误。

## 常见失误

- 背整段答案,忘词就卡死 → 改背结构框架。
- 只答 Yes/No 不展开 → 至少讲 2-3 句话。
- 过渡词单一,一直 and → 交替使用衔接表达。

examples.en: Well, to be honest, I've never thought about that question before.
examples.cn: 嗯,说实话,我之前从没想过这个问题。
examples.note: 开场填充语争取思考时间,保持语流。

examples.en: That's a good question. Let me think about it for a second.
examples.cn: 这是个好问题。让我想一下。
examples.note: 遇到难题时的自然拖延策略。

examples.en: On the one hand, it saves time; on the other hand, it costs more.
examples.cn: 一方面它节省时间,另一方面它花费更多。
examples.note: On the one hand...on the other hand 对比结构。

examples.en: For example, I remember spending a whole weekend learning to cook.
examples.cn: 例如,我记得花了一整个周末学做饭。
examples.note: For example + 个人经历,让回答更生动。

errors.wrong: 直接回答 Yes 或 No 就结束。
errors.right: Yes/No 后继续展开观点、原因与例子。
errors.note: 口语题要求展开,2-3 句话起步。

errors.wrong: 全程只用 and 连接观点。
errors.right: 交替使用 first of all, besides, most importantly 等衔接词。
errors.note: 衔接词多样体现 Coherence。

errors.wrong: 背整段模板答案,一忘就卡壳。
errors.right: 背结构框架,用自己的内容填充。
errors.note: 背框架比背答案更灵活、更抗打断。
